description_plain: While creating the VMS for visitor, it was found that multiple entry has been created by system for the same visitor. Requesting you to please delete the same. SCREENSHOT IS ATTACHED FOR YOUR REFERENCE PLEASE.
comments:
1. The client reported that duplicate entries are generated in the VMS front desk menu. For instance, if we register 1 visitor, then 70-80 duplicate entries are automatically generated for the same visitor with a "-10000000" visit ID. 
2. I opened the front desk menu and filtered the date from January 1, 2024, to June 19, 2024, and found more than 800 duplicate entries across all Zydus locations. 
3. To resolve this issue, I took the Zydus server database and first backed up all visitor data with the following query: 
Select * into Visitor_19072024 from Visitor 
4. After taking the backup, I executed the following query to identify "-1" entries with different location IDs: 
Select * from Location Select * from Visitor(Nolock) where locationid='1' and Visitid='0000000000-1' 
5. I found numerous duplicate entries location-wise and proceeded to delete them one by one using the following query: 
Delete from Visitor where id='575821' 
6. After removing all duplicate entries from the system, no additional duplicate entries are showing in the front desk menu.

description_plain: Since last two working days don't know why but the last out punch is not getting registered? pls do let me know. Employee id 144362
comments:
1. The client reported that employee punches have not been showing up in the attendance sheet for the past 2-3 days.
2. I checked the employee master miscellaneous menu and found that only punches from the 15th of August are present on the device.
3. I opened the database menu and discovered that one attendance device has been showing as inactive in the software since the 15th of August, which is why attendance punches have been pending on the device.
4. I accessed the Zydus server and verified that the IP is showing as active. I then opened the bootloader application and confirmed that the device parameters were correct, so I proceeded to update the device firmware.
5. After updating the firmware, the device is now active in the software database, all pending transactions have been cleared, and attendance punches are now displaying correctly in the software.

description_plain: Please Check our new joiners are facing issue as per attached please check and confirm. When try to login in the software showing error "unauthorized user" on the web page. 148581 148588 148584 148585 148582 148586 148583 148590 148587
comments:
1. The client reported that the iApp login for 9 new joiners is not working, and when they try to log in, an error message appears on the web page saying, "User is unauthorized on this page."
2. I requested that the client share the employee login credentials so I could check the issue from my end as well.
3. After receiving the login credentials, I logged into the employee accounts and found that the error indicated the user was not unauthorized for this page.
4. I accessed the user group in the admin login and searched for all users in the web portal, but no users were found on the page.
5. I added the users to the web portal one by one with their IDs and passwords. After doing this, I checked the user login again, and the error was resolved. The iApp software is now working fine.

name: iApp
description_plain: We need to replace two devices because the old ones are too old and not working properly.
comments:
1. The client needed to replace the old device because it was not working.
2. I guided them to enter the IP address, subnet mask, and gateway for the new device. The IT person entered this information, but only one device's IP showed as active on the Zydus server, while the other did not.
3. I asked them to share the gateway they had entered and found that it was incorrect. I advised them to update the gateway, but the IP was still inactive.
4. I suggested changing the IP address of the device. After the IP change, both device IPs showed as active on the server.
5. I then updated the firmware of both new devices and saved the device parameters using the bootloader application.
6. I opened the software, removed the old configured devices, and added both new devices in the canteen system, successfully saving their parameters.
7. I performed a factory reset on both devices from the server and initiated the user dump process for each device one by one.
8. I waited for the user dump process to complete on both devices.
9. After the activity was completed, I guided them to perform a punch on the device. An error indicated that the printer was disconnected, so I advised them to go to the network parameters, select printer settings, and disable the BLE printer setting.
10. Following this, a card format error appeared. I instructed them to go to user settings and set the card format for clock data on both devices.
11. Both devices are now working fine.

name: iApp
description_plain: Need to interchange the gn1 device to gn packing.
comments:
1. The client wants to interchange the device to another room because the current room is not working. I suggested changing the device and configuration, noting that user dump activity is not required for this device.
2. They need to add the GN1 device to all GN2, GN3, GN4, and GN5 access groups. I opened the access groups menu and added the GN1 device to all access groups.
3. After that, I started the user dump process for all GN2, GN3, GN4, and GN5 devices, and am waiting for the process to complete.
4. The user dump process is now complete, and the device interchange is finished. However, the device is still not showing as active on the database page.
5. I advised them to contact their IT team to check for any network-related issues.
solution:
1. The client informed me that the device is now active. I checked the server and found that the device's IP is showing as active, but the device itself is inactive in the software. I opened the bootloader application and discovered that the device gateway was incorrectly defined, so I updated the device gateway.
2. After that, I opened the software, edited, and saved the configured device, and now the command is going through successfully.
3. I performed a factory reset on the device and started the user dump process, waiting for it to complete.
4. The user dump process is now complete, and the GN-PKG device is working fine.

ticket_title: Problems observed in ARSwin Software related to shift attendance and OT
description_plain: This is purely a software setup requirement. We have observed some problems mentioned in excel sheet and need the changes for actions.
comments: We will connect shortly.
solution:
We took remote session of the user and understood below issues and provided resolution according to this,
1.Shift wise- not calculation hours as  like (Gen Shift  09:30 to 07:30) but in Time 09:00 am out time 19:00 mark present because complete 10 hours- not Calculation as per shift 
> ARS > Set up > General Set up > Untick the Actual Work Hours > Tick Shiftwise Work Hours > Save
2.Systems Present – (Gen2 -08:00-17:00) But In Time -11:00 am  Out Time 20:00 systems mark present 
>Ars > Master > Leave > Day Shift > Edit > Untick Include early in work Hours > Save
3.Right now system is calculating OT hours based on his IN time and Out Time Irrespective of his scheduled working hours. Example Shift is 9:30 Am to 19:30 And employee is coming at 9:00 and  going on 21:15 then system his considering 2:15 Hours and giving him 2 hours OT.
Ars > Master > Leave > Day Shift > Edit > Untick Include late in work Hours > Save

ticket_title: Some of employees data is not showing in Ars Win Net Software as data is available in Com Soft
description_plain: Some of employees data is not showing in Ars Win Net Software as data is available in Com Soft
comments: 7757065056 - schedule remote on tomorrow
solution: As we checked and found only 1st shift is work on as per swipe movement while other shift are working without swipe movement. Due to that while employee made only single punch on one day and made next punch on another day than it will consider to same day punch. After changing did the reprocess data hence issue has been resolved. We also guided them to reprocess the data for the employee whom getting issue. As we checked max hour of shift hour is 9:30hr and some employee work 10hr so as per max hr their out punch is reflect in next date punch and due to that all other date punches were not shows as per date. We increase the max work hr to 12:30hr and than reprocess the attendance for all employee. Hence time shows correctly as per date.

name: iApp
ticket_title: Configuration of Proximity Card for Access Control System
description_plain: Configuration of Proximity Card for Access Control System
comments: We called the user and learned that they are experiencing a flood situation at their location, making it impossible for them to connect with us. They will reach out once the situation is under control.
solution:
We conducted a remote session with the user to understand their requirements. The requirement was that only one employee, a technician, should have access to all doors using a card, while all other devices would operate in fingerprint mode.

To address this, we performed the following steps:

1. The user has over 20 devices, each with over 10,000 pending transaction records. Since the user was not aware of the card ID, we downloaded data from one device and asked the user to use a card so we could obtain the card ID.

2. In Net Xs Control, we went to Employee Master > Add, created an employee named "Test," and assigned a card ID to this employee. We then selected all the gates under Reader Selection and saved the configuration.

3. In Net Xs Control, under Utility > Finger Parameter, we read the current settings, changed the Fingerprint Compulsory option to "No," and wrote the new settings.

Now, the employee can punch in using a card at all the devices.

name: iApp
description_plain: During lunch operation today it is observed that below device is malfunctioning and punching is not captured. We have get it checked by our IT team and found there is no power issue. Need your help to restore the device on priority.
comments:
1. The client reported that the device is not working and shows an error when punched.
2. I opened the database page, and the canteen device appeared correctly, so I took the Zydus server to check the device.
3. I opened the bootloader application and checked the device firmware, which was outdated, so I updated the firmware of the Unistamp 3S device.
4. After that, the punch function was working, but the device restarted every time after a punch.
5. I factory reset the device and started the user dump process.
6. I checked and found that many transactions were pending, so the user dump process did not start and the command was pending.
7. From the Sikkim location, some users started the user dump process for 12-15 devices, so I updated the cancel command and then waited for all the pending transactions to clear.
8. I waited some time for the user dump process to start.
solution:
1. The user dump process is complete, but an error message indicating that the printer is disconnected appeared.
2. I guided the user to unlock the device, go to the network settings menu, and select the printer settings.
3. I instructed them to disable the printer slip; after doing so, the punch and device are now working fine.

name: iApp
description_plain: Hi Spectra team, Sign-in -out spectra machine of unit 1 & unit 2 is not working, Kindly rectify & resolve on priority.
comments: We have mailed user to provide remote at their convenience time.
solution:
We conducted a remote session with the user and found that employees were unable to punch out on the Sign-out Face Scribe device. Additionally, punching in through the card was not working for any employee.

To resolve the issue, we performed the following steps:
1. In the app, navigate to Access Control Management > Device Operation > Database > Selected Device > Sync > User.
2. In Access Control Management > Configuration, set the Card format and saved the changes.

Despite these actions, the card still did not work. We then accessed the Face Portal of the device and compared its configuration with other devices. We discovered that the configuration was incorrect. We updated the MQTT setting from Wiegand port to Wiegand port + Switching and changed the Card bit pattern from 34 Bit (24+8) to 32 Bit.

The same issue was occurring across all IN/OUT devices, so we checked and corrected the configuration on all devices as needed. We also informed the user that this issue might have been caused by editing and saving the control panel, as this action could automatically revert the configuration to default settings.

description_plain: Spectra team, Please give a support to resolve this. From: Dharmendra Sindha Sent: 29 August 2024 13:23 To: 'support@spectra-vision.com' <support@spectra-vision.com> Cc: Jignesh Parmar <jignesh.parmar@neogenchem.com>; Krunal Mehta <krunal.mehta@neogenchem.com> Subject: Leave Policy Updation Spectra Team, I am Dharmendra Sindha from Neogen chemicals Ltd. With reference to above subject, we have to update existing leave policy. Please give your time slot. Dharmendra Sindha Sr.Executive – HR & Admin Mo No. 9909956331
comments: We conducted a remote session with the user and found that they want to create a new Leave Group. We have requested a policy document to create and test the leave configuration on our end before implementing it on your system.
solution: We conducted a remote session with the user and found that the user wanted to create a new leave type, EL (Earned Leave). We followed these steps to create the new leave type: 1. Navigate to iApp > Attendance Management > Shift & Leave Type > Leave Type > New > EL > Save After creating the leave type, we needed to add this leave to a leave group and create a policy according to the user's requirements: 1. Navigate to iApp > Attendance Management > Shift & Leave Type > Leave Group > Add New Leave Group > EL (Earned Leave) > Configure Policy > Save The user currently has CL (Casual Leave), PL (Privilege Leave), and SL (Sick Leave) types with balances. They want to transfer all existing leave balances to EL and delete the other leave types. To facilitate this, we created a CSV file template with columns for EmpCode, EmpName, and Leave Adjustment Quantity. We instructed the user to create four Excel sheets, marking the leaves to be added with a (+) sign and those to be removed with a (-) sign. Additionally, we requested the user to create four separate CSV files for each leave type so that we can upload them in Import Data.1. To add EL leave in bulk, we did the following: - Go to App > Settings > Data Management > Import Data. - Add the CSV file for Leave Adjustment with an effective date of August 1. - Validate and save the data. 2. After that, we removed all other leave types for employee ESS login: - Go to App > Attendance Management > Shift & Leave > Leave Group. - Edit all leave settings, restrict leave for the ESS portal, and save the changes. Now, all leave-related issues have been resolved from our side.

description_plain: This is to inform you that, the security monitoring not working properly at GRPPL Plant, consequently below following exception are raising, · The record have not found of passed days in security monitoring of visitor/Employee, · The fixture between spectra application and turnstile is not suitable, many times the employee out of premises with turnstile punching but there is no update in the application. 2. I then deleted the old muster settings and created new muster settings for the GRPPL location.
3. I advised the user to close the application, restart it, and then check the data from today.

name: iApp
ticket_title: Few swipes are not captured from Face reader to I app
description_plain: We are using FaceReader in our Chennai Everi India office. However, since the 28th, some swipes are not showing in the I app. When I log in to FaceReader, the logs are visible. Could you please call me and guide me on what we can do? Is there an option to sync the data manually?
comments: We will connect tomorrow.
solution:
"We conducted a remote session with the user and discovered that some employees' punch data was not reflecting in the IApp application. We found that while all punch data was visible in the face portal, it was missing in IApp. To address this issue, we accessed the server and executed the following query to identify the missing data:

`SELECT * FROM Trans WHERE Dataframe LIKE "%Employee Code%"`

We discovered that the missing data had a status of NULL. To retrieve this data, we needed to change the status from NULL to S, but this was not happening. With guidance from a senior team member, we updated to the latest version of IApp (4.0.1.67) on the system. After performing the same query again, we found that all the pending records had been removed. We have asked the user to observe the changes over the next few days. The issue has been resolved."

ticket_title: it is showing an error as duplicate controller ID.
description_plain: They added a few controllers initially with auto generated controller code. If they edit the same controllers it is showing an error as duplicate controller ID. Since the code is auto generated & incremental order, one should not be able to add the controllers with the same controller code in the first place.
comments: As we checked earlier when they were using MVC version, while adding controller its generate same code with different location. That time controller 14 is inactive. Than they update the IApp version to core and in that controller code is note same for different location. It will auto generated while adding the controller. So now while activate the old controller 14 it shows the error duplicate controller code. As suggested by development team we update the controller code from backend database. First we took the backup of controllermaster table. Select * into controllermaster30082024 from contyrollermaster. Than update the controller master. UPDATE CONTROLLERMASTER SET CODE = RIGHT('00000' + CAST((SELECT COUNT(*)  FROM CONTROLLERMASTER AS c WHERE c.controllertypename NOT LIKE '%FaceScribe%' AND c.id <= CONTROLLERMASTER.id) AS VARCHAR(5)), 5) WHERE controllertypename NOT LIKE '%FaceScribe%';

name: iApp
description_plain: When employee click on the login page showing error that "user is not authenticated for this page" User ID 103302 Password :- Nirja@0806
comments:
1. The client reported that the iApp login is not working, and when attempting to open the software, an error message appears stating, "User is not authenticated for this page."
2. I accessed the login page and encountered the same error.
3. I then accessed the Zydus server and executed the following queries in the database:
   - `SELECT * FROM UserMaster (NOLOCK) WHERE empid='9185'`
   - `SELECT * FROM usersettings WHERE category LIKE '%UserDefaultURL%' AND id='9217'`
4. I found an incorrect filter in the results, so I deleted the filter with the following query:
   - `DELETE FROM usersettings WHERE category LIKE '%UserDefaultURL%' AND id='9217'`
5. After deleting the filter, I reopened the login page, and the iApp login is now functioning correctly.
solution:
1. The client reported that the iApp login is not working, and when attempting to open the software, an error message appears stating, "User is not authenticated for this page."
2. I accessed the login page and encountered the same error.
3. I then accessed the Zydus server and executed the following queries in the database:
   - `SELECT * FROM UserMaster (NOLOCK) WHERE empid='9185'`
   - `SELECT * FROM usersettings WHERE category LIKE '%UserDefaultURL%' AND id='9217'`
4. I found an incorrect filter in the results, so I deleted the filter with the following query:
   - `DELETE FROM usersettings WHERE category LIKE '%UserDefaultURL%' AND id='9217'`
5. After deleting the filter, I reopened the login page, and the iApp login is now functioning correctly.

Now, all the data is appearing correctly in the attendance sheet and reports.

name: CommunicationSoft
ticket_title: Data is not retrieving in the SPECTRA software.
description_plain: Data is not retrieving in the SPECTRA software.
comments: We have called user and they  have arranged teams meeting for tomorrow at 10:30 AM.
solution:
New communication software exe updated and face scribe parameter changes as per below :-

1) In the Facescribe Admin Portal:
   - Go to **MQTT**.
   - Ensure that the following four options are set to **Upload**:
     - **Identification Record**: Upload with Picture
     - **QRCode**: Upload
     - **ID Card**: Upload
     - **IC or RF Card Number**: Upload

2) For downloading old data:
   - In the Facescribe Admin Portal, navigate to **MQTT**.
   - Enable **Resume from Breakpoint**.
   - For old data download, set **Retransmission Start Time** to when the data was not downloaded.

After changes in facescribe device all data downloaded.
And Communication software installation one another system.

ticket_title: data mismatch between the FTP and Spectra software
description_plain: data mismatch between the FTP and Spectra software
comments: As discussed on call they will provide remote after some time.
solution:
During the remote session, we identified that punch data loss was occurring due to an issue with the FTP server. Additionally, the client requested an automatic email notification if any device goes offline. We configured this by following these steps:

Settings: Created a lookup type.
Master: Created a lookup.
Access Control > Configuration: Created a mail template.
Access Control > Device Manager: Created an access zone.
Access Control > Configuration: Created a door event configuration.
This setup ensures that the client receives automatic email notifications if any device goes offline.

name: iApp
description_plain: Employee attendance not showing properly.
comments:
Certainly! Here's a revised version of the sentence:

We took a remote session with the user and found that there was an issue with attendance data. One employee's IN punch was at 13:00 and OUT punch was at 22:00, while their assigned shift was from 11:00 to 19:30. This resulted in total work hours showing as 9 hours, with extra work hours showing as 2:30 hours.

Upon investigation, we found that the user had created a shift with a Maximum Work Hours of 23:59 and Extra Grace Time for Entry/Exit set to 23:59. This configuration caused the system to show the employee as present for 6 hours of work even though it was beyond the shift hours, leading to additional work hours being recorded as extra work.

To rectify this issue, we adjusted the attendance policy by deselecting the "Extra Work After Shift End" option and selecting "Actual vs. Expected Work Hours" as per the user's requirements. We verified this change by applying it to one employee, and it is working correctly.

One employee's IN punch was at 13:00 and OUT punch was at 22:00, while their assigned shift was from 11:00 to 19:30. This resulted in total work hours showing as 9 hours, with extra work hours showing as 2:30 hours.

Upon investigation, we found that the user had created a shift with a Maximum Work Hours of 23:59 and Extra Grace Time for Entry/Exit set to 23:59. This configuration caused the system to show the employee as present for 6 hours of work even though it was beyond the shift hours, leading to additional work hours being recorded as extra work.

To rectify this issue, we adjusted the attendance policy by deselecting the "Extra Work After Shift End" option and selecting "Actual vs. Expected Work Hours" as per the user's requirements. We verified this change by applying it to one employee, and it is working correctly.

name: iApp
description_plain: Hi Team, We initiated a location transfer for an employee from one location to another. However, after completing the transfer, we noticed that the attendance management count has increased. It appears that the attendance management location was not updated during the transfer process. Could you please assist in updating the attendance management location to reflect the correct count? Thank you for your prompt attention to this matter.
comments:
Discussed with Mr.Senthil,
He will provide remote access when he arrives at the office.
solution:
We took a remote session with the user and found that the attendance license count had not decreased after the employee was relieved; it remained the same. To resolve this issue, we performed the following steps:

1. Go to **App > Master > Employee**.
2. Select **Edit**.
3. Navigate to **Attendance**.
4. Remove the **Access Group**.
5. Click **Save**."

Now reported issue has been resolved.

name: iApp
description_plain: Two canteen devices are showing inactive in the software that's why data are not showing in the software. As discussed pls resolved the issue so that we can generate the canteen invoice.
comments:
1. The client reported that the canteen report was not generated. I accessed the report and generated it successfully.
2. After that, I discovered that two canteen devices have been showing as inactive since 29/08/2024, resulting in 2 days of pending data stored on the devices.
3. I accessed the Zydus server, pinged the IPs of the devices, and found that both IPs were showing as inactive. I have shared this information with the client.
solution:
1. The client called me with their IT team, and I discussed the issue with them. They checked the IPs of both devices on their network.
2. They found that the IP cable for one device was not working, so they replaced the cable, and now the IP is functioning for that canteen device.
3. The other canteen device's IP was working locally. I advised them to connect both sides of the cable—one to the device and the other to the laptop—and then connect the laptop to a hotspot. Despite this, the IP was still not working.
4. They replaced the device adapter, and now both devices' IPs are working properly. The issue was identified as being with the device adapter.
5. I requested them to wait a while to clear the pending transactions for both canteen devices.
6. The pending transactions for both devices have been cleared, and the data is now showing properly.

description_plain: As per installed system we are facing a problem regarding system software which is not working properly.
comments: We took a remote session with the user and discovered that they have a new Biosatmp 2c device and want to add it to the NetXs software. However, when we clicked on the controller option, an OCX error appeared. We re-registered the OCX file, but the device still did not show up in the boot loader. We then asked the user to connect the device to the laptop via a LAN cable so we can change the device IP and add it to the software.
solution: "We took a remote session with the user and discovered that while trying to add a controller in the Net Xs Controller software, an OCX error occurred. We registered the OCX files, which allowed us to add the controller to the software. However, the device was not coming online, so we asked the user to check the network connectivity, as the ping was not responding. The user informed us that they had a new device and wanted to configure it in the software. We instructed them to connect the device to the laptop via a LAN cable so we could find the device details in the bootloader and assign a new IP address. After changing the device IP, we added the device to the software using the following steps: 1. **NetXs > Master > Controller > Add > Fill in all details > Save.** We then created a new TimezoneXs Group: 1. **NetXs > Groups > TimezoneXs Group > New > Create New Group > Add Device > Save.** We asked the user to edit an employee’s profile and assign the new TimezoneXs group to the employee. After adding the new group and selecting the new gate, the user was able to punch in on the device. We also guided the user through the new finger registration process."

description_plain: MR SOHAN SINGH MOVEL CODE 45507 ON DATE 08.05.2024 -SHOW 3 C/OFF.KINDLY CHECK AND CORRECT
comments:
Please execute below query and provide output:
WITH lvdetailsCTE AS (
  SELECT 
    lv.companyid,
    lv.locationid,
    lv.empid,
    lv.category,
    lv.leaveid,
    lv.leavedate,
    COUNT(*) AS CountValue
  FROM lvdetails lv
  WHERE 
    lv.category = 'OTL' 
    AND lv.leavedate >= TO_DATE('01-JUN-2022', 'DD-MON-YYYY')
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 
      FROM lvtran 
      WHERE category = 'LST' 
        AND lvtran.EmpId = lv.empid
    )
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 
      FROM changelocation ch 
      WHERE ch.EmpId = lv.empid
    )
  GROUP BY 
    lv.companyid, lv.locationid, lv.empid, lv.category, lv.leaveid, lv.leavedate
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 2
),
adjustCTE AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT 
    lvdetailsCTE.companyid,
    lvdetailsCTE.locationid,
    lvdetailsCTE.empid,
    lvdetailsCTE.category,
    lvdetailsCTE.leaveid,
    lvdetailsCTE.leavedate,
    lvdetailscte.countvalue,
    am.weekoff,
    am.holiday,
    am.firstin,
    am.lastout,
    am.otsanc,
    am.workhour,
    am.extrawork,
    ad.userid, 
    ad.category AS ad_category,
    ad.attddate,
    ad.f1,
    ad.f11,
    ad.laststatus,
    ud.overtimepolicy,
    os.fieldname,
    os.fieldvalue
  FROM adjustapply ad
  INNER JOIN lvdetailsCTE ON ad.userid = lvdetailsCTE.empid AND ad.attddate = lvdetailsCTE.leavedate
  INNER JOIN usermapping ud ON ud.userid = lvdetailsCTE.empid
  INNER JOIN Othersetup OS ON os.id = ud.overtimepolicy
  INNER JOIN Attdmain am ON am.empid = lvdetailsCTE.empid and  am.attddate = lvdetailscte.leavedate
  WHERE 
    ad.category IN ('OverTime') 
    AND os.fieldname IN ('IsSingleDayOverTime', 'SnglDay_OT_Hours_For_NormalDay', 'SnglDay_OT_Hours_For_WeekOff', 'SnglDay_OT_Hours_For_Holiday')
)
SELECT
  ad.companyid,
  ad.locationid,
  ad.empid,
  ad.category,
  ad.leaveid,
  ad.leavedate,
  ad.countvalue,
  ad.weekoff,
  ad.holiday,
  ad.firstin,
  ad.lastout,
  ad.otsanc,
  ad.workhour,
  ad.extrawork,
  ad.userid,
  ad.ad_category,
  ad.attddate,
  ad.f1,
  ad.f11,
  ad.laststatus,
  ad.overtimepolicy,
  MAX(CASE WHEN ad.fieldname = 'IsSingleDayOverTime' THEN ad.fieldvalue END) AS IsSingleDayOverTime,
  MAX(CASE WHEN ad.fieldname = 'SnglDay_OT_Hours_For_NormalDay' THEN ad.fieldvalue END) AS SnglDay_OT_Hours_For_NormalDay,
  MAX(CASE WHEN ad.fieldname = 'SnglDay_OT_Hours_For_WeekOff' THEN ad.fieldvalue END) AS SnglDay_OT_Hours_For_WeekOff,
  MAX(CASE WHEN ad.fieldname = 'SnglDay_OT_Hours_For_Holiday' THEN ad.fieldvalue END) AS SnglDay_OT_Hours_For_Holiday
FROM adjustCTE ad
GROUP BY 
  ad.companyid,
  ad.locationid,
  ad.empid,
  ad.category,
  ad.leaveid,
  ad.leavedate,
  ad.countvalue,
  ad.weekoff,

  ad.attddate,
  ad.f1,
  ad.f11,
  ad.laststatus,
  ad.overtimepolicy
ORDER BY 
  ad.userid,

WITH cte AS (SELECT JSON_VALUE (O.FIELDVALUE, '$[0].condition') AS CONDITION_1,
                    JSON_VALUE (O.FIELDVALUE, '$[0].OtHrsFROM') AS OTHRSFROM_1,
                    JSON_VALUE (O.FIELDVALUE, '$[0].OtHrsTO') AS OTHRSTO_1,
                    JSON_VALUE (O.FIELDVALUE, '$[0].LeaveQty') AS LEAVEQTY_1,
                    JSON_VALUE (O.FIELDVALUE, '$[1].condition') AS CONDITION_2,
                    JSON_VALUE (O.FIELDVALUE, '$[1].OtHrsFROM') AS OTHRSFROM_2,
                    JSON_VALUE (O.FIELDVALUE, '$[1].OtHrsTO') AS OTHRSTO_2,
                    JSON_VALUE (O.FIELDVALUE, '$[1].LeaveQty') AS LEAVEQTY_2,
                    O.COMPANYID,
                    O.LOCATIONID,
                    O.CODE,
                    O.name,
                    O.FIELDNAME,
                    O.ID
      FROM OTHERSETUP O
      WHERE O.CATEGORY = 'OverTimeSetup'
        AND O.FIELDNAME IN ('SnglDay_OT_Hours_For_Holiday', 'SnglDay_OT_Hours_For_NormalDay', 'SnglDay_OT_Hours_For_WeekOff')
        AND O.FIELDVALUE != '[]'),
  MainDataPolicy AS (SELECT AO.ID,
                            AO.COMPANYID,
                            AO.LOCATIONID,
                            AO.CATEGORY,
                            AO.USERID,
                            AO.ATTDDATE,
                            AO.F11,
                            LVD.LEAVEDATE,
                            LVD.LVDIDCNT,
                            LVD.LVDID,
                            LVD.QTY,
                            LVD.LVDQTY,
                            U.OVERTIMEPOLICY OTPOLICY
      FROM ADJUSTAPPLY AC
        INNER JOIN ADJUSTAPPLY AO
          ON AC.ORIGID = AO.ID
          AND AO.CATEGORY = 'OverTime'
        INNER JOIN (SELECT L.EMPID,
                           L.LEAVEDATE,
                           SUM(L.QTY) QTY,
                           COUNT(L.ID) LVDIDCNT,
                           LISTAGG (L.ID, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY L.LEAVEDATE) LVDID,
                           LISTAGG (L.QTY, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY L.LEAVEDATE) LVDQTY
            FROM LVDETAILS L
            WHERE L.CATEGORY = 'OTL'
            GROUP BY L.EMPID,
                     L.LEAVEDATE) LVD
          ON LVD.EMPID = AO.USERID
          AND AO.ATTDDATE = LVD.LEAVEDATE
        INNER JOIN USERMAPPING U
          ON AO.USERID = U.USERID
      WHERE AC.CATEGORY = 'OverTimeCancel')
SELECT *
  FROM (SELECT M.ID,
               M.CATEGORY,
               M.USERID,
               M.ATTDDATE,
               M.F11,
               M.LEAVEDATE,
               M.LVDIDCNT,
               M.LVDID,
               M.QTY,
               CASE WHEN NVL(LEAVEQTY_2, 0) > LEAVEQTY_1 THEN LEAVEQTY_2 ELSE LEAVEQTY_1 END AS MAXQTYGET,
               M.LVDQTY,
               M.OTPOLICY,
               P.CODE,
               P.name,
               P.FIELDNAME
      FROM MainDataPolicy M
        INNER JOIN ATTDMAIN AM
          ON AM.EMPID = M.USERID
          AND AM.ATTDDATE = M.ATTDDATE
        INNER JOIN cte P
          ON M.OTPOLICY = P.ID
          AND P.FIELDNAME = (
          CASE WHEN AM.WEEKOFF = 'W' THEN 'SnglDay_OT_Hours_For_WeekOff' 
               WHEN AM.HOLIDAY = 'H' THEN 'SnglDay_OT_Hours_For_Holiday' 
               ELSE 'SnglDay_OT_Hours_For_NormalDay' END
          ))
  WHERE QTY <> MAXQTYGET

description_plain: Please refer below screen shot for contract employee. Emp Code: DE00229 Emp Name : Manish Chandravansi Please investigate as policy assign in contract master but shown in employee.

name: iApp
description_plain: Biomini finger access still query not resolve. PARMAR SONALBEN MJ000403
comments:
1. The client reported that the BioMini finger access is not working, and the red light on the device is not blinking when attempting to use it.
2. I checked from here and advised them to verify whether the Spectra Client Service is running. If the service is stopped, they should start it and then check again.
solution:
1. I connected to the client and now spectra client service uninstallation completed so i start the biomini installation activity.
2. I install the spectra client service but service policy is disable in the system so he took 15 minutes to enable the service and then after i install the spectra client service.
3. Next, install the Suprema BioMini Plus2 driver on the system. Check in the Control Panel to ensure both the Spectra Client service and Suprema drivers are visible.
4. Navigate to the Spectra Client folder, copy all files, and paste them into the following path:
C:\Program Files (x86)\Spectra\Spectra Client\. 
Grant full administrator rights (Everyone) to the Spectra Client folder after pasting.
5. Proceed to the Suprema BioMini Plus 2 folder. Copy the files as indicated below and paste them into the following paths:
 Paste into: C:\Windows\System32\
 Paste into: C:\Windows\sysWOW64\ 
6. Install the x64 and x86 library files on the system as specified.
7. Access the services and start the Spectra Client service. Once the service is running, the BioMini installation is complete. 

Proceed to the iApp login and Employee Master. Click "Take Finger," then place the finger on the device when the red light blinks to register it on the software.

comments:
We conducted a remote session with the user and discovered that two employees' leave balances were showing as negative. Upon investigation, we found that the users had applied for leave even though they did not have any leave available. We reviewed the policy and confirmed that negative leave balances are not allowed. It appears that there may have been a temporary change in policy that allowed leave applications despite the negative balance. To rectify this issue, we adjusted the leave balances using the following steps:

Go to App > Attendance Management > Leave > Leave Adjustment.
Make the necessary adjustments.
Save the changes.

description_plain: Dear Team, This is to inform you that, Time mismatch issue between our access control system and the controllers. The time displayed on the controllers does not match the time on our system. Kindly check and do the needful on priority. Thanks &
comments:
We have called the client on 09/09/2024 and informed us that sir will aligned someone to guide us for further action
Today we have again call but no response
solution:
It sounds like you're dealing with a device where the date and time settings are incorrect, which could affect various functionalities, including firmware updates and database timestamps. Here's a summary and a few recommendations based on your description:

a) Date and Time Syncing:

You’ve already synced the date and time on the device. Monitor if these settings remain correct after the sync.
If the date and time continue to be incorrect, you might need to update the device's firmware.

b) Firmware and IAPP Version Update:

If syncing the date and time doesn’t resolve the issue, updating the firmware and the IAPP (presumably an application or interface component) might be necessary to fix any underlying bugs or improve synchronization functions.

c) Database Time Display:

The database screen shows the time when the page was opened. If the time display is incorrect or not updated as expected, refreshing the page should help update the accurate date & time that is shown on the device with the correct time. The time index in the database aligns with the device’s date and time settings and not the real-time.

Action Steps:

1. Verify Date and Time: Check if the device’s date and time settings stay accurate after the sync.

2. Update Firmware and IAPP: Proceed with updating if issues persist.

3. Refresh Database Page: Regularly refresh the page to ensure it accurately displays the current time.

ticket_title: Leave Policy Update for other location
description_plain: As you are aware, our Leave Policy has changed and you have done necessary changes in Spectra System for our Dahej Unit. Like that please do the change for our Neogen Chemicals Ltd. and Neogen Ionics Ltd. Karakhadi Units Also. Attached are the Opening Balance of EL of respective employees.
comments: Need to discussed with team.
solution:
We conducted a remote session with the user and found that the user wanted to create a new leave type, EL (Earned Leave). We followed these steps to create the new leave type: 1. Navigate to iApp > Attendance Management > Shift & Leave Type > Leave Type > New > EL > Save After creating the leave type, we needed to add this leave to a leave group and create a policy according to the user's requirements: 1. Navigate to iApp > Attendance Management > Shift & Leave Type > Leave Group > Add New Leave Group > EL (Earned Leave) > Configure Policy > Save The user currently has CL (Casual Leave), PL (Privilege Leave), and SL (Sick Leave) types with balances. They want to transfer all existing leave balances to EL and delete the other leave types. To facilitate this, we created a CSV file template with columns for EmpCode, EmpName, and Leave Adjustment Quantity. 
1. To add EL leave in bulk, we did the following: - Go to App > Settings > Data Management > Import Data. - Add the CSV file for Leave Adjustment with an effective date of August 1. - Validate and save the data. 2. After that, we removed all other leave types for employee ESS login: - Go to App > Attendance Management > Shift & Leave > Leave Group. - Edit all leave settings, restrict leave for the ESS portal, and save the changes.

9. I requested them to please go to the reader's location and provide us with the correct MAC address of the reader so I can investigate the actual issue.

description_plain: Kindly refer below mentioned SS, he was worked 15-Aug in first shift also his 8.30 HRS OT approved still his C-Off not generated for that day. Plz check.
comments:
1. Opening the attendance sheet, we found that overtime application had already been approved, but the coff count was showing as zero. 
2. We discovering the bug, we immediately solved the issue due to the pending payroll process. 
3. Therefore, we cancelled the overtime application in the attendance sheet. 
4. To check the application status, we executed the following query: 
SELECT * FROM EmpMaster WHERE Code='146294' 
SELECT * FROM adjustapply(nolock) WHERE userid='96410' AND attddate='2024/08/15' AND category = 'Overtime'; 
5. The last status for the application was showing as 'G', so we updated it as 'P'. 
6. Upon reprocessing the attendance sheet, the application was now showing as pending at the approver. 
7. Having approved the application from the sanction list, the coff count now showed properly.

description_plain: The device is formatted, so I need a data dump on it urgently.
comments:
1. The client wants to dump the data onto the device, so I opened the database menu in the software.
2. I found that the device was showing as inactive in the database menu, so I discussed it with the client and guided them to check the device connectivity first. After that, I asked them to update me so I could proceed with further steps.
solution:
1. The client reported that the device requires a user dump process because it has been idle for a long time.
2. I checked the IP, which is pinging on the server. I then opened the bootloader application, searched for the device, and updated its firmware.
3. After the update, I opened the software, but the device was still showing as inactive. I executed the following queries in the database:
   - `SELECT * FROM controllermaster WHERE IPaddr=''`
   - `SELECT * FROM machinedata (NOLOCK) WHERE controllerid='' AND status='P'`
4. I found more than 1000+ machine data entries pending on the device. I executed the following query to clear all pending machine data:
   - `DELETE FROM machinedata (NOLOCK) WHERE controllerid='' AND status='P'`
5. After deleting the machine data, I opened the Hercules application and performed a factory reset on the device using the following command:
   - `36 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 36 00`
6. The device is now showing as active in the database, so I set the card format of the device.
7. I then started the user dump activity on the device and waited for it to complete.
8. The user dump activity is now completed, and the device is working fine.

description_plain: As per trailing mail or earlier communication. Please ensure that this communication is rolled out at every location, and communication should be sent to user when a visitor enters the premises. Default message "This is an electronically generated message by the system, please do not reply to this message For any clarity, please contact at Security Gate." Please update when implement at ground. Following visitor has signed out on 02/09/2024 18:00 hrs Name : TEST Spectra1 TEST Spectra1 Company : spectra Mobile No. : 9712551705 Visitor Code : 651847
comments:
1. Client need to set the automatic message when visitor arrival to the location.
2. I need some clarity about this so i mailed to the client that When visitor registration is completed, a message is sent to the visitor confirming their registration or instructing them to check in upon arrival at the premises.
solution:
1. The client reported that currently there are two notifications being sent to the host: one for visitor registration and one for visitor arrival. They need only the visitor arrival notification to be active.
2. We need to deactivate the visitor registration notification for all Zydus locations and activate only the visitor arrival notification.
3. I opened the visitor category page and found that there are 200 visitor categories available, used by the users location-wise.

name: iApp
description_plain: Please find attached screenshot, showing error as per attached Screenshot and there are many entries of a Visitor Mr. Karan Sanjeeb rameshwarlal not able to close it. Kindly resolve the concern.
comments:
1. The client reported that duplicate entries are generated in the VMS front desk menu. For instance, if we register 1 visitor, then 70-80 duplicate entries are automatically generated for the same visitor with a "-10000000" visit ID. 
2. I opened the front desk menu and filtered the date from January 1, 2024, to June 19, 2024, and found more than 60 duplicate entries for dabhasa Zydus locations. 
3. To resolve this issue, I took the Zydus server database and first backed up all visitor data with the following query: 
Select * into Visitor_16092024 from Visitor 
4. After taking the backup, I executed the following query to identify "-1" entries with different location IDs: 
Select * from Location Select * from Visitor(Nolock) where locationid='7' and Visitid='0000000000-1' 
5. I found numerous duplicate entries location-wise and proceeded to delete them one by one using the following query: 
Delete from Visitor where id='575821' 
6. After removing all duplicate entries from the system, no additional duplicate entries are showing in the front desk menu.
solution:
1. The client reported that duplicate entries are generated in the VMS front desk menu. For instance, if we register 1 visitor, then 70-80 duplicate entries are automatically generated for the same visitor with a "-10000000" visit ID. 
2. I opened the front desk menu and filtered the date from January 1, 2024, to June 19, 2024, and found more than 60 duplicate entries for dabhasa Zydus locations. 
3. To resolve this issue, I took the Zydus server database and first backed up all visitor data with the following query: 
Select * into Visitor_16092024 from Visitor 
4. After taking the backup, I executed the following query to identify "-1" entries with different location IDs: 
Select * from Location Select * from Visitor(Nolock) where locationid='7' and Visitid='0000000000-1' 
5. I found numerous duplicate entries location-wise and proceeded to delete them one by one using the following query: 
Delete from Visitor where id='575821' 
6. After removing all duplicate entries from the system, no additional duplicate entries are showing in the front desk menu.

3. To resolve this issue, I took the Zydus server database and first backed up all visitor data with the following query: 
Select * into Visitor_16092024 from Visitor 
4. After taking the backup, I executed the following query to identify "-1" entries with different location IDs: 
Select * from Location Select * from Visitor(Nolock) where locationid='30' and Visitid='0000000000-1' 
5. I found numerous duplicate entries location-wise and proceeded to delete them one by one using the following query: 
Delete from Visitor where id='575821' 
6. After removing all duplicate entries from the system, no additional duplicate entries are showing in the front desk menu.

   The PL policy was set to grant 1 PL day if an employee works for 20 days in a month, but it was not functioning as expected.  
   **Spectra Comment:** We updated the PL leave policy according to the requirements. Since similar issues were reported by another client and resolved with an update, we applied the latest version to address this problem.

   The user requested that employees should apply for leave on the week off if they take leave before and after the week.  
   **Spectra Comment:** We have created a new sandwich rule as per the user's requirement.

4. **COFF Policy Configuration**  
   The COFF policy was set so that employees working more than 4 hours are eligible to apply for COFF. However, employees can currently apply for COFF after just 2 hours of extra work.  
   **Spectra Comment:** This needs to be discussed with Setul Sir.

   The auto report scheduler is not working. Scheduled reports were not being sent as expected. We found that reports are sent correctly when specific employees are selected, but not for specific email addresses.

description_plain: Please configure the new device on an urgent basis for the HR & Admin department on the 3rd floor.
comments:
1. The client reported that a new attendance device needed to be configured on an urgent basis.
2. I accessed the Zydus server, pinged the IP address, and confirmed that it was connected properly. I then opened the bootloader application and updated the firmware of the device.
3. I used the Hercules application to execute the following command to factory reset the device:
   ```
   36 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 36 00
   ```
4. After that, I opened the software, added the new device, and saved the device parameters. However, the command did not go through. I checked the bootloader application and found that the gateway was incorrect, so I updated the gateway settings.
5. With the correct gateway set, the command was executed successfully. I then configured the card format for the device.
6. I went to the attendance settings, added the device, and disabled the free scan mode on the device.
7. I updated the access groups by adding the device to the appropriate group. I then started the user dump process on the device and waited for it to complete.
8. After the process was completed, the device is now working fine.

description_plain: Below listed employee , Whose finger shows a finger note match even after finger is already existing in system. 120860 135569 86508 123615 141979 136173 43768 42708 125284 143084 138780
comments:
1. The client reported that many new employees’ finger access is not working on the attendance device, showing the error "finger not matched."
2. I opened the employee master and checked the fingerprints, which were displaying properly in the software.
3. I went to the "Get Finger" menu and fetched the fingerprints, and two fingerprints were showing correctly.
4. After that, I went to the "Assign Access" menu and reassigned access to the employee; the command was successful.
5. I requested them to please try punching again, but the same error was still showing on the device.
6. I started the user dump activity on the device and waited for some time for it to complete.
7. After completing the process, more fingerprints were showing in the database page, and the device was working fine.
solution:
1. The client reported that many new employees’ finger access is not working on the attendance device, showing the error "finger not matched."
2. I opened the employee master and checked the fingerprints, which were displaying properly in the software.
3. I went to the "Get Finger" menu and fetched the fingerprints, and two fingerprints were showing correctly.
4. After that, I went to the "Assign Access" menu and reassigned access to the employee; the command was successful.
5. I requested them to please try punching again, but the same error was still showing on the device.
6. I started the user dump activity on the device and waited for some time for it to complete.
7. After completing the process, more fingerprints were showing in the database page, and the device was working fine.

ticket_title: Finger adding issue in bio-metric device
description_plain: Dear Team, We are facing our biometric device. We are unable to add fingers in biometric devices. Kindly support. My contact no. is 9987664439 Thanks &
comments:
During our remote session, we have created a new Time zone group for Gurugram location and added that location in another group also.

For the finger-adding issue, please select 'Add Employee Finger' on the controller and then save.

Please confirm on your end and let us know if any further assistance is required.
solution: We conducted a remote session with the user and explained that in Template 1, we can register only one finger, either the left index finger or the right index finger. In Template 2, we can register both the right index and left index fingers simultaneously. To do this, after issuing the 'scan finger' command, a green light will appear on the device. The user needs to tap their first index finger two times. After two taps, a low beep sound will occur, and then they should place the second index finger in the same manner, which will produce a high beep sound. We have verified this process with your Gurugram employee, Ms. Manshi Sharma, who confirmed that after using Template 2 and following the registration process, she can successfully punch in on the device with both index fingers. Please check & confirm by re-register all employees' fingers who are facing this issue and let us know if you require any further assistance from our side.

6. I advised the client to mention the time on the waiver according to the employee's late hours.

8. I started the user dump activity on the device and waited for some time for it to complete.

name: NetXsControl Ent.
ticket_title: Vulnerability of Existing HID Access card
description_plain: Vulnerability of Existing HID Access card
comments: We called but not responded
solution:
I wanted to address your recent concerns regarding the security of the access control system we installed. After a thorough review, I can confirm that the system itself is functioning as intended. However, the HID card technology currently in use is known to have vulnerabilities that make it easier to clone, you can check it on internet also.

As per records at your site Spectra Access Control Panels are installed along with HID Prox readers, now control Panel will check and validate data coming from HID reader and based on that providing access for door, if your card is cloned one then it will give same data to HID reader and reader will provide same data to Controller.

To enhance security and prevent such incidents in the future, I recommend transitioning to a higher-security card technology. These advanced options offer significantly improved protection against cloning and unauthorized access.

All the missing data has been restored, and the current punch data is now showing, as confirmed by the user.

solution:
1. The client reported that when trying to use finger access on the biomini, an error message stating "finger access failed" appears.
2. I requested remote access to investigate the issue, and after some time, the client provided it.
3. I opened the control panel and noticed that the Spectra Client service was not showing. However, it was listed in the services, so I requested the IT team to remove the Spectra Client service so I could reinstall it.
4. The IT team attempted to remove the service multiple times but was unsuccessful. Eventually, they removed the system policy, successfully deleted the Spectra Client service, and then restarted the system.
5. After the restart, I began the installation and installed the Spectra Client service along with the Suprema drivers.
6. I granted full rights to the relevant folder and transferred the necessary files to the Windows Sys32 and SysWOW64 folders.
7. I then installed the library files, started the Spectra Client service, and confirmed that the biomini finger access is now working fine.

comments:

2. Despite trying to delete the late permission, the same message persisted. 
3. To address this, we accessed the Zydus database and executed the following queries: 
Select * from empmaster where code='' 
SELECT * FROM adjustapply(nolock) WHERE userid='94565' AND attddate='2024/08/08' AND category = 'Late'; 
4.After removing the late permission, we redirected to the attendance page. However, the same error persisted when attempting to change the shift. To resolve this, we executed the following query to set the early flag to NULL mode: 
Select * from attdmain where empid='' and attddate='' 
5. With this adjustment, the employee was able to change the shift as needed.

name: iApp
description_plain: When I try to delete the late coming application, it shows an error. Could you please help me delete it? Employee id 134518 and date 02/09/2024
comments:
1. We opening the attendance sheet, we noticed that the shift information was incorrect. When attempting to apply for a shift change, a message indicated that late permission had already been approved for the day. 
2. Despite trying to delete the late permission, the same message persisted. 
3. To address this, we accessed the Zydus database and executed the following queries: 
Select * from empmaster where code='' 
SELECT * FROM adjustapply(nolock) WHERE userid='134518' AND attddate='2024/09/02' AND category = 'Late'; 
4.After removing the late permission, we redirected to the attendance page. However, the same error persisted when attempting to change the shift. To resolve this, we executed the following query to set the early flag to NULL mode: 
Select * from attdmain where empid='' and attddate='' 
5. With this adjustment, the employee was able to change the shift as needed.

name: iApp
description_plain: VMS is not working in ZAHIL Plant. Kindly resolve the issue please
comments:
1. The client reported that the VMS is not working, so I opened the software and found that it was stuck on the loading page and would not open.
2. I tried logging in and out multiple times, but I encountered the same issue, as it was running very slowly.
3. After that, I accessed the Zydus server and noticed it was hanging, so I opened the Task Manager and saw that CPU utilization was normal, ranging between 30% and 40%.
4. I opened the IIS server, stopped the process, and waited for some time to allow it to complete.
5. After stopping the process, I waited a bit and then restarted it. Now the software is functioning normally.
solution:
1. The client reported that the VMS is not working, so I opened the software and found that it was stuck on the loading page and would not open.
2. I tried logging in and out multiple times, but I encountered the same issue, as it was running very slowly.
3. After that, I accessed the Zydus server and noticed it was hanging, so I opened the Task Manager and saw that CPU utilization was normal, ranging between 30% and 40%.
4. I opened the IIS server, stopped the process, and waited for some time to allow it to complete.
5. After stopping the process, I waited a bit and then restarted it. Now the software is functioning normally.

comments:

2. I then accessed the Zydus server, pinged the IP, and confirmed that the device IP is active.
3. I opened the bootloader application, searched for the device, and found that the device parameters were correct, so I updated the firmware.
4. After the update was completed, the device still showed as inactive, so I updated the MAC address in the software, but the device remained inactive.
5. I went to the database and executed the following queries:
   - `SELECT * FROM controllermaster WHERE ipaddr=''`
   - `SELECT * FROM machinedata WHERE controllerid='' AND status='P'`
6. I found that there are more than 4,000 transactions pending on the device, which is why it is showing offline. The pending transactions are clearing slowly, so I requested the client to please wait for some time until all the pending transactions are cleared from the device.

description_plain: The repaired device has been received, and the IP address needs to be changed and configured.
comments:
1. The client reported that he connected the device to his laptop, but it is still not appearing in the bootloader application, preventing him from changing the device's IP.
2. I took remote access of the client’s laptop and pinged the device's IP, but it was inactive. I then checked the IPv4 network settings.
3. I entered the device IP as 192.100.100.45 and searched for the device in the bootloader; it then appeared. After that, I returned to the IPv4 settings, added the IP to the network range, and set the subnet mask accordingly.
4. Afterward, I went back to the bootloader application, and the device was displaying correctly. I changed the device IP, configured the settings, and now the device IP is set properly and is pinging actively.

description_plain: Dear Spectra Team, Data Centra Access issue has been surfaced regarding the facility staff member is able to access the Data Centre despite his access is being revoked. Kindly get this resolved.
comments:
We conducted a remote session with the user and found that some employees do not have access to the Data Center door, yet they are still able to punch in on the device.

As a primary troubleshooting step, we dumped the user data on the device, suspecting that a delete command might be pending. However, even after dumping the data, the user was still able to punch in.

Further investigation revealed that the user’s card ID is showing as surrendered in the employee master, and the same card ID is assigned to the same employee in the card inventory. We surrendered the card again and reassigned it to the same employee, but the user is still unable to punch in at that door.

Now the user wants to access the same door, so we assigned access to it, but the user is still unable to punch in on the device. We have performed multiple troubleshooting steps, such as deleting the face from the face portal and registering a new face, but the issue persists.

The user will connect tomorrow at 3 PM for further checks.

Further investigation revealed that the user’s card ID is showing as surrendered in the employee master, and the same card ID is assigned to the same employee in the card inventory. Now the user wants to access the same door, so we assigned access to it,and now all the employees are punching successfully.

description_plain: Below interns work from home entry has been updated in system from HR end & details are also reflecting in attendance view. But same is not reflecting in Remote work application. 391824 - Rittika Manoj Rijhwani
comments:
We have reviewed attendance data, attendance punch details, user logs, and remote work application records.

In the Attddetails table, punches are present, but the typeismanual column is set to 'M'. When these punches are reprocessed, they appear as "Remote" in the workplace column.

Upon analyzing our source code, we found that in an older version of the mobile ESS, remote work applications were being deleted, which prevented punches from being processed correctly for remote work. As a result, the attendance records incorrectly display "Remote" in the workplace column.

This issue has now been resolved and will be included in the next package release.

Below is the query to identify instances where the attendance sheet shows "Remote" in the workplace column, but no corresponding remote work application exists.
SELECT am.* FROM eams.attdmain am LEFT JOIN eams.adjustapply ad ON ad.userid = am.empid AND (am.attddate BETWEEN ad.dt1 AND ad.dt2 or am.attddate between ad.attddate and ad.attddate)AND lower(ad.category) = 'remotework' WHERE lower(am.workplace) = 'remote' AND am.attddate>='01-JUN-2022' AND ad.userid IS NULL

ticket_title: Staff members are not appearing in the webportal
description_plain: staff members are not appearing in the webportal user groups to move them into the newly created group.
comments:
We conducted a remote session with the user and found that they are unable to view employee details in the web portal. Upon checking, we discovered that the employees who cannot be viewed are not registered in the ESS login. We reviewed the notification log and found that all ESS login requests are pending, while some have been successful. The employees with a successful status are showing in the web portal, but those pending are not. We sent a new ESS request, which is also in pending status.

To address this, we performed an email configuration test and saved the settings, which the client confirmed as correct. We suggested to the client that we can only trigger an ESS request, and the status (pending or successful) depends on whether the SMTP server is allowing or blocking something. However, the client indicated that since some email statuses are successful while others are pending, there is likely no issue from the SMTP side, and we need to investigate further on our end.
solution:
During today's remote session, I performed the necessary actions to resolve the issue of ESS emails being sent to employees, as outlined below: 

- The first step was removing all the pending emails from the backend.

- In the second step, I checked the email configuration and updated the 'Emails sent per hour' field to 1000.

- In the third step, I restarted the Spectra Worker services and verified the changes

- In the fourth step, I resent the ESS email invitations to all employees whose invitations were pending, and had one or two employees log in to verify.


Please ensure that all employees log in to ESS and verify, and provide me with confirmation

ticket_title: Assistance Needed with Employee Deletion in Master Data
description_plain: encountering an issue in the Employee Master Data while trying to delete an employee for the software in Space & The system is indicating: User dependency found (Punch found)
comments:
We took remote session of the user and found that user is trying to register new employee, but he is getting error License Exceed Error.
We also found user directly delete employee to make space of license. We suggested that it is not suitable to delete employee instead we guided him with below steps, to resign the employee:
iApp > Masters > employee master > resign > select employee > select, resign/relieved > save.
solution:
During a recent remote session with the user, we identified that they encountered a "License Exceed Error" while attempting to register a new employee. Upon further investigation, we discovered that the user had directly deleted an employee in an effort to free up a license.

We advised against this approach, as it is not advisable to delete employee records. Instead, we provided the user with the following steps to properly resign the employee:

Navigate to iApp > Masters > Employee Master.
Select the employee to be resigned.
Choose the "Resign/Relieved" option.
Save the changes.

name: CommunicationSoft
description_plain: Installation
comments: As discussed during our remote session, the client needs to back up important files and folders before proceeding with the OS update. We have agreed to install the software on Thursday morning at 10:30 AM.
solution:
As discussed during our remote session, the client needs to back up important files and folders before proceeding with the OS update. We requested that they install SQL. During the remote session, we discovered that the user wants to change the server system for the communication software. 

To fulfill the user's requirements, we performed the following steps: 

1. Backed up the communication software database from the old server.
2. Backed up the communication application folder from the old server.
3. Installed SQL 2014 on the new server system.
4. Restored the communication software database on the new server system.
5. Pasted the communication application folder backup on the new server system.
6. Created a new path file according to the new SQL credentials.

The application is now running smoothly, but the device is not online due to firewall restrictions. We have asked the client to remove these restrictions and to inform us if there are any further issues. 

The firewall restrictions have since been removed, and we have verified that the software is functioning correctly. There were concerns regarding the security of changing ports, but we confirmed that port 1883 is the only port available for device communication. Hence, issue is resolved.

comments:
1. The client reported that the device is showing as inactive in the system, so I opened the database menu in the software and found that the device is showing offline.  
2. I accessed the Zydus server and pinged the device's IP, which was active. I then searched for the device in the bootloader, and it was found.  
3. I discovered that the device port and server port were incorrectly configured, so I updated both ports and restarted the device.  
4. After that, I set the card format for the device, but it was not sensing the card, so I updated the device's firmware to the latest version.  
5. The card sensing issue persisted, so I performed a factory reset on the device, uploaded the user dump, and set the card format again, but the issue remained.  
6. I requested the client to send the device to the Spectra service center so our hardware team can check and resolve the issue.
solution: The laundry device has been received, and I have already sent it to the hardware team for repairs.

ticket_title: Employee Punching issue. On face scribe.
description_plain: Employee Punching issue. On face scribe.
comments:
We conducted a remote session with the user and found that one employee is able to punch in on the face recognition device in the morning, and this is reflected in the attendance sheet. However, the employee is unable to punch in on the device in the evening, which is showing as a stranger.

We checked and identified on the face portal that the allowed access punch is recorded in the captured log, while the access denied punch is in the stranger capture log. For further investigation, we need to discuss with internal team.
solution:
We took a remote session with the user and found that only one employee is experiencing issues with the Face Scribe device—sometimes they can punch in, and other times they cannot.

Upon checking the face portal system parameters, we discovered that the LED was scheduled to be on during specific times. This might cause interference if two lights reflect, preventing the system from recognizing the face correctly.

For now, we have turned off the LED option and asked the user to check if the issue persists today.

description_plain: Request to please help us delete the miss punch of below employee. Employee id 145814 and date 08/09/2024
comments:

3. After that, I accessed the Zydus server and executed the following queries: ```sql 
SELECT * FROM EmpMaster WHERE Code='145814'; 
SELECT * FROM adjustapply (nolock) WHERE userid='95221' AND attddate='2024/09/08' AND category='mispunch'; 
DELETE FROM adjustapply WHERE userid='95221' AND attddate='2024/09/08' AND category='mispunch'; ``` 
4. The misspunch application has now been deleted, and the user is able to change the employee's shift.
solution:
1. The client was unable to change the shift due to a misspunch that had been approved by the user. They needed to delete the misspunch application, but when they tried, an error message stated that the misspunch application is already approved in the system. 
2. I opened the attendance sheet for the employee and attempted to delete the application, but I encountered the same error. 
3. After that, I accessed the Zydus server and executed the following queries: ```sql 
SELECT * FROM EmpMaster WHERE Code='145814'; 
SELECT * FROM adjustapply (nolock) WHERE userid='95221' AND attddate='2024/09/08' AND category='mispunch'; 
DELETE FROM adjustapply WHERE userid='95221' AND attddate='2024/09/08' AND category='mispunch'; ``` 
4. The misspunch application has now been deleted, and the user is able to change the employee's shift.

description_plain: I have noticed that August-24 around 35 visitor passes show duplicate entry same date. But due to an error in the VMS system, we are not able to checkout by VMS system. Please do the needful Attached screen shot for your reference.
comments:
1. The client reported that duplicate entries are generated in the VMS front desk menu. For instance, if we register 1 visitor, then 330 duplicate entries are automatically generated for the same visitor with a "-10000000" visit ID. 
2. I opened the front desk menu and filtered the date from June 1, 2024, to Oct, 2024, and found more than 330 duplicate entries for Zpl Zydus locations. 
3. To resolve this issue, I took the Zydus server database and first backed up all visitor data with the following query: 
Select * into Visitor_08082024 from Visitor 
4. After taking the backup, I executed the following query to identify "-1" entries with different location IDs: 
Select * from Location 
Select * from Visitor(Nolock) where locationid='6' and Visitid='0000000000-1' 
5. I found numerous duplicate entries location-wise and proceeded to delete them one by one using the following query: 
Delete from Visitor where id='666167' 
6. After removing all duplicate entries from the system, no additional duplicate entries are showing in the front desk menu.
solution:
1. The client reported that duplicate entries are generated in the VMS front desk menu. For instance, if we register 1 visitor, then 330 duplicate entries are automatically generated for the same visitor with a "-10000000" visit ID. 
2. I opened the front desk menu and filtered the date from June 1, 2024, to Oct, 2024, and found more than 330 duplicate entries for Zpl Zydus locations. 
3. To resolve this issue, I took the Zydus server database and first backed up all visitor data with the following query: 
Select * into Visitor_08082024 from Visitor 
4. After taking the backup, I executed the following query to identify "-1" entries with different location IDs: 
Select * from Location 
Select * from Visitor(Nolock) where locationid='6' and Visitid='0000000000-1' 
5. I found numerous duplicate entries location-wise and proceeded to delete them one by one using the following query: 
Delete from Visitor where id='666167' 
6. After removing all duplicate entries from the system, no additional duplicate entries are showing in the front desk menu.

name: iApp
description_plain: Could you please see and resolve the below error coming while checking time and attendance. Emp id - 149537
comments: I need access to the Zydus server to check this concern, but the issue is coming from Zydus HO, so the server is not working. I will be waiting for some time.
solution:
1. The client reported that when they try to log in with employee ID 149537, an error message appears stating, "User is not authorized for this page."
2. I accessed the Zydus server and executed the following queries to check if any filters were applied:  
   `SELECT * FROM UserMaster (nolock) WHERE empid='8870'`  
   `SELECT * FROM usersettings WHERE id='27' AND category LIKE '%filter%'`  
   I then deleted the settings with the category 'FILTERING' where the ID was '27.'
3. I did not find any filters, so I went to the user group, selected the web portal, searched for the employee, and did not find the employee ID. I then added the employee, inserted the user ID and password, and added them to the user group.
4. The employee's login is now working properly.

name: NetXsControl Ent.-100
ticket_title: Adding new card/ finger on biometric
description_plain: We are facing issue of adding new card / finger on biometric reader due to event log full. Event log full snap attached for your kind references. Please help to resolve this issue on priority as our engineer Mr. Amresh (8577865050)
comments: We requested our team to share remote charges.
solution:
We installed the SQL but error shows Exit code (decimal): 2061893607 error discription : "Could not find the Database Engine startup handle" . This is because on systems running Windows 11, some new storage devices and device drivers expose a disk sector size larger than the supported 4 KB sector size. When this happens, SQL Server cannot start because of the unsupported file system because SQL Server currently supports sector storage sizes of 512 bytes and 4 KB.

1. We open Command Prompt and run as administrator.
2. Copy this command fsutil fsinfo sectorinfo C: and run in command prompt.
3.  Copy below command and run in Command Prompt to update the values - REGADD"HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\stornvme\Parameters\Device" /v "ForcedPhysicalSectorSizeInBytes" /t   REG_MULTI_SZ /d "* 4095" /f
4. You will see “The operation completed successfully” after run.
5. Delete all setup of SQL and restart the system.
6. Insatlled the SQL and attached the old database.
7. Installed the NetXs software and requested our team to provide new activation key.
8. Getting activation key paste in software folder and generate requeste license key.
9. Share request license key with our team and get final license key.
10. Attached the final license key in application folder and run the application.
Also add new device and made sample punch on it.

comments:

3. I accessed the Zydus server, opened the services log data, and copied all the log files for 07/10/2024.  
4. I opened the log extractor application, extracted the log file, filtered by employee card ID, and found no missing transactions for that day; I received only two transactions.  
5. I concluded to the client that only two transactions were found from the device.

ticket_title: Showing other unit data in security monitor
description_plain: Kindly check the below mentioned Employee Head count list of ZLL Goa. It is reflecting data in Sr. No 135 & 136 of Other Unit Employee of Moriya Location in ZLL Goa list. Please check their Punch date & Punch Location details.
comments:
1. Right now, free scan is enabled on the "Goa-Security Control Room" device, which is why cross-punch concerns were found. We have disabled the free scan mode on the device.
2. If we run system on "Only Finger(Free-scan)" mode then system checks the bio-metric against all other bio-metric registrations present in the device database and allows access to the closest match.
3. When employee do punch, the transaction get stored on account of other employee due to cross punching. since system found closest match of other employee.
4. Its a myth that all bio-metrics in the world are 100% unique and hence to obtain maximum security and accuracy, its a industry standard to follow "card+finger" mode.
solution:
1. Right now, free scan is enabled on the "Goa-Security Control Room" device, which is why cross-punch concerns were found. We have disabled the free scan mode on the device.
2. If we run system on "Only Finger(Free-scan)" mode then system checks the bio-metric against all other bio-metric registrations present in the device database and allows access to the closest match.
3. When employee do punch, the transaction get stored on account of other employee due to cross punching. since system found closest match of other employee.
4. Its a myth that all bio-metrics in the world are 100% unique and hence to obtain maximum security and accuracy, its a industry standard to follow "card+finger" mode.
