name: ARSWin-Net
description_plain: we are facing an attendance downloading issue from past two weeks
comments: As per the client's confirmation via email, we will connect at 3 PM.
solution: We conducted a remote session with the user and found that while employees' punch data is reflecting in the attendance software, it is not showing in the third-party table. Some employees' data is displayed for the dates 8th, 9th, and 10th October, while some data is missing from the third-party table. We observed that the downloading EXE is running on two systems, which is causing the data to split across different systems and not push to the third-party table. We assured the user that the missing data will appear if it is available in both systems' log files, but any already stored punch data will be duplicated. We took the log files from the server and client systems. After merging both files, we created a new log file and read it again on the server. We also deleted the downloading EXE from the client system. The user will check and confirm if the new attendance data is coming through or not, and any missing data will need to be regularized manually.

description_plain: Hi Team, Kindly help with recovery of missing punched for the period 07th Oct to 08th Oct.
comments: Assign to Millan
solution:
we have prepared SQl query using JOin and inserted into TRNPUNCH table  

SELECT  l.name AS Location_Name,cp.name AS Company_Name ,cm.code AS Device_Code,cm.name AS DEVICE_Name,a.name,a.empcode ,a.cardnumber,a.sitecode,

gs.gatedesc AS Access_AREA ,gs.GateNo AS DoorID ,t.inout,t.errdesc AS Event ,t.punchdetail AS PunchTime

FROM Trans t  
INNER JOIN company cp  ON t.companyid=cp.id

INNER JOIN  Location l  ON t.locationid= l.id

INNER JOIN ControllerMaster cm ON t.cid= cm.id 
 
INNER JOIN GateSetup gs ON t.GateID=gs.id 

FULL join AllUsers a ON t.EmpID=a.id 

WHERE t.ErrDesc='Access Allowed' AND t.cardid IS NOT NULL
AND t.PunchDetail BETWEEN '2024-10-07 00:00:00' AND '2024-10-08 23:59:59'

name: iApp
description_plain: Dear Sir, Today, we allotted an ESS login to our new employee, Rakeshkumar Singh (Emp.No.S193), but encountered the following error. As a result, we are unable to complete his ESS login setup. please assist us in resolving this issue. Server Error in '/' Application. A potentially dangerous Request.Path value was detected from the client (:). Description: An unhandled exception occurred during the execution of the current web request. Please review the stack trace for more information about the error and where it originated in the code. Exception Details: System.Web.HttpException: A potentially dangerous Request.Path value was detected from the client (:). Source Error: An unhandled exception was generated during the execution of the current web request. Information regarding the origin and location of the exception can be identified using the exception stack trace below. Stack Trace: [HttpException (0x80004005): A potentially dangerous Request.Path value was detected from the client (:).] System.Web.HttpRequest.ValidateInputIfRequiredByConfig() +11823941 System.Web.PipelineStepManager.ValidateHelper(HttpContext context) +54 Version Information: Microsoft .NET Framework Version:4.0.30319; ASP.NET Version:4.8.9277.0
comments: Tried to reached client twice, but got no response.
solution:
Since the client was experiencing issues registering a new user in the ESS Portal, we initiated a remote session to attempt logging in through the Web ESS. However, we encountered a 'Server Error' message.

Upon investigating the files in IIS, we discovered an error in the appsettings.json file, which was preventing the user from registering in the web portal. Specifically, the iApp URL was incorrectly configured. We corrected the URL, and after making this change, the error was resolved. The user was then able to log in to the Web Portal successfully.

ticket_title: Employees are not able to login spectra
description_plain: Employees are not able to login spectra
comments: User will connect us after lunch.
solution:
We took a remote session with the user and found that employees are unable to log in to the ESS portal with their credentials, and it is showing an invalid credentials error.

To resolve the issue, we performed the following steps:

1.We added SSO=True in the appSettings.json file, updating it from the old version of the Web.config files.
2.In IIS, two applications cannot run on one application pool, so we created a new application pool for the core version.
3.We enabled all the .NET Core features and App Settings in IIS.
After performing all these steps, the issue was resolved.

name: iApp
description_plain: Please note that still 11th and 13th October, 2024 attendance data is not captured properly. 1. 28156 Deepak Baghel 2.13576 Rushiraj Shukla 3.139131 Sanjay Rohit 4.84961 Ranjeet Kajave
comments:
1. The client reported that attendance data for October 11th and 13th is not showing in the attendance sheet.
2. As per the client's examples, I opened the employee master, went to the miscellaneous menu, and found that only access transactions are displayed, while attendance data is missing.
3. After that, I opened the database menu in the software and found that all devices are showing as active, with no pending transactions.
4. I accessed the Zydus server, went to the services folder, and copied all the log files for October 11th and 13th, then extracted all the files using the log extractor application.
5. I filtered the data by employee card ID and found missing transactions for both dates.
6. To recover all log files, I first needed to determine how many attendance devices were available at that location, and I found there were 45 devices.
7. I checked each device in the attendance settings, copied the MAC address of each device one by one, and retrieved the data log files for October 11th and 13th for each device.
8. I created a recovery folder in the services menu since all the devices are 2C devices. I then restarted the Spectra worker process, and after some time, all the data was read successfully.
9. I waited for a while, but the data still did not show in the attendance sheet, so I executed the following queries to check if the data flags were incorrect:
   ```
   SELECT * FROM empmaster WHERE code='';
   SELECT * FROM attdetails WHERE empid='';
   ```
10. I did not find any read data, so I discussed the issue with Setul sir. He tried several times to check the data, but no updates were found.
11. I need to discuss other employee data with the client.
solution:
1. I received reports from the client regarding more than four employees, and upon checking the attendance sheet, I found that attendance data is missing for all employees on the date of 13/10/2024.  
2. I discussed this issue with Setul sir, took the Zydus server, and extracted the log file from 11/10/2024 to 13/10/2024 using the log extractor. I filtered the data by card ID and confirmed that the data is not showing in the software.  
3. I discovered that the MAC addresses were incorrect for five log entries, which I copied and organized into a separate folder.  
4. I identified that one device had a main parking issue, resulting in a significant amount of data not being received for the date of 13/10/2024. I opened the log file and replaced the incorrect MAC addresses with the correct ones.  
5. After updating the log files, I copied all the revised entries and pasted them into the recovery folder, then restarted the Spectra worker service.  
6. Finally, I opened the software, and the attendance data is now displaying correctly.

description_plain: Moraiya-2 location employees are not showing in my login.
comments:
1. The client reported that Moraiya-2 location employees are not appearing in my login, nor in Mr. Preash Makwana's login.
2. I opened Mr. Jignesh Prajapati's login and found that Moraiya-2 contract employees are not showing.
3. I checked the user group and confirmed that location rights are already assigned for that user, yet the employees are still not appearing.
4. I accessed the Zydus server and executed the following query to check for any duplicate entries with an ID of '-1':
   `SELECT * FROM allusers (NOLOCK) WHERE id='-1'`
5. I found one contract employee showing with an employee ID of '-1'.
6. I discussed this case with Setul sir, who updated the sequence ID for that user and deleted the duplicate entry for that employee.
7. After that, I re-logged into the software, and now the contract employees are displaying correctly.

4. I accessed the Zydus server, opened the database, and executed the following queries:

   - `SELECT * FROM allusers WHERE empcode=''`  
5. I found the card ID for that user in the backend data, so I went to the card inventory and surrendered the card of the contract employee.  
6. After that, I went to the master menu, reassigned the card ID to the contract worker, and refreshed the page; now the card ID is showing correctly in the master.
solution:

ticket_title: Not able to delete outdoor duty
description_plain: We cant able to delete Outdoor duty 03 OCT 2024. (Because employee apply OD Multiple time) Employee No: 137742- Tushar Vyas
comments:
1. Client reported that multiple outdoor duty applied on the date of 03/10/2024 wrongly and that's why he is not able to update the attendance punch.
2. Despite trying to delete the outdoor duty, the same message persisted. 
3. To address this, we accessed the Zydus database and executed the following queries: 
Select * from empmaster where code='' 
SELECT * FROM adjustapply(nolock) WHERE userid='78482' AND attddate='2024/10/03' AND category = 'OD'; 
4.After removing the late permission, we redirected to the attendance page. However, the same error persisted when attempting to change the shift. To resolve this, we executed the following query to set the early flag to NULL mode: 
Select * from attdmain where empid='' and attddate='' 
5. With this adjustment, the employee was able to update the attendance now.

name: iApp
description_plain: When user tries to login through id password in ESS Mobile App, an error called 'Id Password invalid' shows.
comments:
Yesterday, when the user was unable to join through the ESS Mobile app, we attempted to register using the web portal. The user was able to log in with their ID and password on the web portal, but they could not log in on the ESS Mobile app.

To troubleshoot, we first ran a query to check for any rights restrictions on the user, but there were none. We then opened IIS > iApp > ESS > Files and checked the properties. We discovered that a version update for the iApp had been performed a few days prior, but the ESS Mobile version had not been updated. We proceeded to update the ESS Mobile version to the latest one.

Next, we checked the appsettings.json file and found that the IP address of the server was incorrect, which was causing connectivity issues between the server and the mobile app. After correcting the IP address, the user was able to log in to the ESS Mobile app successfully.
solution:
Yesterday, when the user was unable to join through the ESS Mobile app, we attempted to register using the web portal. The user was able to log in with their ID and password on the web portal, but they could not log in on the ESS Mobile app.

To troubleshoot, we first ran a query to check for any rights restrictions on the user, but there were none. We then opened IIS > iApp > ESS > Files and checked the properties. We discovered that a version update for the iApp had been performed a few days prior, but the ESS Mobile version had not been updated. We proceeded to update the ESS Mobile version to the latest one.

Next, we checked the appsettings.json file and found that the IP address of the server was incorrect, which was causing connectivity issues between the server and the mobile app. After correcting the IP address, the user was able to log in to the ESS Mobile app successfully.

ticket_title: New punching machine configuration (MFG – ENGG & EHS New)
description_plain: Dear Team, Request you to please configuration new punching machine details in the I Spectra system for company employee. Device Name: MFG – ENGG & EHS New Thank You
comments: I kindly request that the client share the device serial number so I can check from my end as well.
solution:
1. The client reported that they need to install a new purchase device because the old device is not working.
2. I discussed the issue with the client and guided them to insert the IP address, subnet mask, and gateway of the device.
3. After that, I took the Zydus server and pinged the IP address, which was active. Then, I opened the bootloader application and updated the firmware of the Bioscribe 2C device.
4. I opened the Hercules application and performed a factory reset on the device using the following command:
   ```
   36 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 36 00
   ```
5. After that, I opened the software, added the parameters, and saved them. All the device parameters were saved successfully.
6. I set the card format of the device, then went to the access group and added the device to the old access group.
7. I navigated to the database page, started the user dump activity, and waited for some time for it to complete.
8. After completing the process, the device is now working fine.

description_plain: We are replaced faulty device with new procured BSP-3S-P. kindly do the system setting & revert. IP Address : 172.24.131.164 .
comments:
1. The client needs to replace the old device because it is not working.
2. I obtained the serial number of the device and discussed it with the AMC team, confirming that the device is under warranty.
3. I accessed the Zydus server, pinged the device's IP, and confirmed that the device is active. After that, I opened the bootloader application to configure the device parameters and updated the firmware of the Bioscribe 3S device.
4. In the software, I marked the old device as a dummy and added the new device.
5. I set the device parameters, and the commands were successful. I then proceeded to the device operation and performed a factory reset on the device.
6. I configured the card format for the device, opened the access group, and added this device to the DC Area group.
7. I initiated the user dump activity and waited for it to complete. The device is now functioning properly.

3. Next, I checked the attendance sheet for extra hours and found that the extra hours are correctly calculated according to the overtime policy.

solution:
1. The client reported that all overtime applications for employee ID 110504 are showing as pending in the system.
2. I opened the employee master record and confirmed that the employee is from the oncology location.
3. Next, I checked the attendance sheet for extra hours and found that the extra hours are correctly calculated according to the overtime policy.
4. I accessed the user hierarchy, selected the overtime hierarchy, and searched for the approval process. I found that the final approval is not defined in the overtime hierarchy, which is why all applications are pending in the system.

description_plain: Attendance data is not showing for employee ID 133226 for the date 07/10/2024.
comments:
1. Client reported that one employee id 133226  attedance data is not showing for the date of 07/10/2024. 
2. I open the employee master and goto the misscellnous menu and attedance data found but its not showing in the attedance spreadhseet.
3. Subsequently, we accessed the database server and executed the following queries: 
SELECT  * from empmaster where code=''
SELECT* FROM AttdDetails(nolock) WHERE processflag='P' AND empid='' 
4. We discovered that entries marked with an 'X' flag, prompting us to change the process flag to 'P' and restart the Spectra worker service. 
SELECT count(*) FROM AttdDetails(nolock) WHERE processflag='X' SELECT * FROM AttdDetails(nolock) WHERE processflag='X' AND punchdatetime BETWEEN '2024-10-07 02:00:01' AND '2024-10-07 02:00:01'
--UPDATE AttdDetails SET processflag='P' WHERE processflag='X' AND punchdatetime BETWEEN '2024-10-07 02:00:01' AND '2024-10-07 00:00:01'-
5. Following the update of the process flag, all data began downloading and eventually cleared after waiting for some time. 
6. Presently, the attendance data is displaying correctly.

description_plain: The QA attendance device is showing as inactive in the software, but the IP is already functioning on the server.
comments:
1. The client reported that the device IP is showing as active, but the device itself is still showing as inactive in the software.  
2. I opened the database page and confirmed that the device is marked as inactive, so I accessed the Zydus server and pinged the IP, which responded correctly.  
3. After that, I opened the bootloader application and restarted the device, but it still showed as inactive after the restart.  
4. I started a ping test and restarted the device, finding that it went offline upon restart, although the device IP continued to respond. This indicates an IP conflict issue, so I shared the data with the client and advised them to connect with their IT team.
solution:
1. The client reported that the device IP is showing as active, but the device itself is still showing as inactive in the software.  
2. I opened the database page and confirmed that the device is marked as inactive, so I accessed the Zydus server and pinged the IP, which responded correctly.  
3. After that, I opened the bootloader application and restarted the device, but it still showed as inactive after the restart.  
4. I started a ping test and restarted the device, finding that it went offline upon restart, although the device IP continued to respond. This indicates an IP conflict issue, so I shared the data with the client and advised them to connect with their IT team.

name: iApp
description_plain: When I tried to apply for leave from 30/09/2024 to 13/10/2024, an error message appeared stating, "Employee was on leave 12/10/2024." Please resolve this issue.
comments:
1. The client encountered an error when trying to apply for a 14-day leave, preventing him from submitting the application.  
2. I opened the attendance sheet and attempted to apply for the leave application, but the same error occurred.  
3. I discovered that on the date 12/10/2024, the week off was not showing as absent, so I checked the sanction application page and found that the week off application had already been rejected, and the week off was inserted manually.  
4. I accessed the Zydus server and executed the following queries:  
   - `Select * from empmaster where code='130364'`  
   - `Select * from adjustapply (Nolock) where userid='56581' and attddate='2024/10/12'`  
5. I found that the week off application was showing for that day, so I removed the week off from the attendance sheet, but the application was still displayed. I then deleted the application from the database using the following command:  
   - `Delete from adjustapply where userid='56581' and attddate='2024/10/12'`  
6. After that, I noticed that the process flag for that day in the attendance sheet was still showing as 'AH.' I discussed this with Setul Sir, who took remote access to the Zydus server and found that the leave flag was incorrect. He updated the process flag, and afterward, I checked the attendance sheet, which now showed "absent" for that day.  
7. I then inserted the week off and applied for the leave application, which is now processing correctly.
solution:
1. The client encountered an error when trying to apply for a 14-day leave, preventing him from submitting the application.  
2. I opened the attendance sheet and attempted to apply for the leave application, but the same error occurred.  
3. I discovered that on the date 12/10/2024, the week off was not showing as absent, so I checked the sanction application page and found that the week off application had already been rejected, and the week off was inserted manually.  
4. I accessed the Zydus server and executed the following queries:  
   - `Select * from empmaster where code='130364'`  
   - `Select * from adjustapply (Nolock) where userid='56581' and attddate='2024/10/12'`  
5. I found that the week off application was showing for that day, so I removed the week off from the attendance sheet, but the application was still displayed. I then deleted the application from the database using the following command:  
   - `Delete from adjustapply where userid='56581' and attddate='2024/10/12'`  
6. After that, I noticed that the process flag for that day in the attendance sheet was still showing as 'AH.' I discussed this with Setul Sir, who took remote access to the Zydus server and found that the leave flag was incorrect. description_plain: The payroll process is running, so I need urgent help to complete it.
comments:
1. The client reported an urgent need for support to complete the payroll cycle at all Zydus locations, one by one.
2. I discussed the issue with the client. When he clicked on the month closure process to start the payroll generation activity for one location, it initiated but then restarted again. After some time, it got stuck, so I needed to cancel the process from the backend, one by one, to allow him to start the process for another location.
3. I accessed the Zydus server, and for the Moraiya location, the process was already completed, but it was still showing as running for the third time, which was incorrect. I executed the following query: 
   ```sql
   SELECT * FROM machinedata (NOLOCK) WHERE CommandType LIKE '%payroll%' AND Status = 'P';
   ```
4. I found that the payroll process was restarting again, so I updated the process flag to 'C' and canceled the process.
5. After that, the client started the process for another location, and during lunch, I completed the month closure process for five locations myself.
6. One by one, as discussed with Mr. Jignesh Prajapati, we completed the month closure process for 50 locations.
7. After completing the process, I generated the payroll process completion list and shared it with the client.

name: iApp
description_plain: Late permission delete issue for the employee id 25890 and date 08/10/2024
comments:
1. I opening the attendance sheet, we noticed that the shift information was incorrect. When attempting to apply for a shift change, a message indicated that late permission had already been approved for that day. 
2. Despite trying to delete the late permission, the same message persisted. 
3. To address this, we accessed the Zydus database and executed the following queries: 
Select * from empmaster where code='25890' 
SELECT * FROM adjustapply(nolock) WHERE userid='25890' AND attddate='2024/10/08' AND category = 'Late'; 
Delete FROM adjustapply(nolock) WHERE userid='25890' AND attddate='2024/10/08' AND category = 'Late'; 
4.After removing the late permission, we redirected to the attendance page. However, the same error persisted when attempting to change the shift. To resolve this, we executed the following query to set the early flag to NULL mode: 
Select * from attdmain where empid='25890' and attddate='2024/10/08' 
5. With this adjustment, the employee was able to change the shift as needed.
solution:
1. I opening the attendance sheet, we noticed that the shift information was incorrect. When attempting to apply for a shift change, a message indicated that late permission had already been approved for that day. 
2. Despite trying to delete the late permission, the same message persisted. 
3. To address this, we accessed the Zydus database and executed the following queries: 
Select * from empmaster where code='25890' 
SELECT * FROM adjustapply(nolock) WHERE userid='25890' AND attddate='2024/10/08' AND category = 'Late'; 
Delete FROM adjustapply(nolock) WHERE userid='25890' AND attddate='2024/10/08' AND category = 'Late'; 
4.After removing the late permission, we redirected to the attendance page. However, the same error persisted when attempting to change the shift. To resolve this, we executed the following query to set the early flag to NULL mode: 
Select * from attdmain where empid='25890' and attddate='2024/10/08' 
5. With this adjustment, the employee was able to change the shift as needed.

name: iApp
description_plain: There is one event observed yesterday in iApp is that, Mr. Jaswan Makwana came out of the aseptic area around 15:33 but during out punching the name of Mr. Yash Rathore appeared in the access device and the door was opened. And when Mr. Yash Rathod was out, he got a local ABP fail error when he punched out and he was not allowed to come out. Refer following screenshot and do the needful ASAP.
comments:
1. The client reported that the wrong name is displayed on the device when Mr. Jaswan Makwana punches in, along with 2-3 other device-related concerns.
2. I discussed this with the AMC team, and according to their instructions, support is not extended, so I transferred this call to the AMC team.
solution:
1. The client reported that the reader punch on both GG01 and GG09 devices is not working.  
2. I requested remote access so I could check the issue from here.  
3. After some time, the client provided remote access. I connected remotely and found that both devices were showing as active, but the reader on GG09 was still not working for all employees.  
4. I performed a factory reset on both the controller and reader of the GG09 device. I then started the user dump process and waited for it to complete. Afterward, I set the card format for the device.  
5. I asked the client to check again, and the access started working, but some employees' access was still not functional.  
6. I reassigned access to the affected employees, and after that, their access started working. I advised the client that if an employee's access is not working, they should reassign it and check again.  
7. I then opened the GG01 device and followed the same process: factory resetting the controller and reader, and setting the card format for both devices.  
8. After that, I started the user dump activity on the GG01 and waited for some time. I then guided the client to have employees try punching on the device, and it started working properly.

name: iApp
description_plain: Our InfoSec team has scanned all the application server’s and find attached extracts from the same for our Spectra application(refer my mail dated 18-01-2024 09:57).
comments: Assign to L2
solution:
Please find below details for ticket TKT020800(VAPT).

1) SSL Certificate - Subject Common Name Does Not Match Server FQDN
    This is not a development-side issue. Options for resolution include:

Generating a new certificate for the IP whenever the IP address changes.
Obtaining a static IP.
Acquiring an FQDN and generating a certificate for that domain.

2) HTTP Security Header Not Detected
    This can be resolved through the "Configuration Editor" by navigating to system.webServer >> security. Click
    "Add," and enter X-Content-Type-Options for the Name field and nosniff for the Value field.

3) Content-Security-Policy HTTP Security Header Not Detected
    The recommended content-security-policy header has been set with the following directive: form-action 'self';.
    Please see the attached screenshot for details. Let me know if further proof of concept (POC) is required.

4) Microsoft ASP.NET HTTP Handlers Enumerated
    This issue is resolved. Attempts to enumerate HTTP handlers now result in an "Oops" page. This has been
    achieved by disabling verbose error messages in .NET via the web.config file.

5) Microsoft IIS ISAPI Application Filters Mapped To Home Directory
    This setting is managed via the Microsoft Internet Information Server plug-in and does not require code changes.
    Appropriate filter settings have been applied.

    This can be resolved through the "Configuration Editor" by navigating to system.webServer >> security. Click

    This issue is resolved. Attempts to enumerate HTTP handlers now result in an "Oops" page. This has been
    achieved by disabling verbose error messages in .NET via the web.config file.

    This setting is managed via the Microsoft Internet Information Server plug-in and does not require code changes.
    Appropriate filter settings have been applied.

name: iApp
description_plain: Employee id 29967- Anurag Katiyar. Can you please check why it has gone to CTO
comments:
1. The client reported that the reporting manager is not showing as per the Darwin box that sent the string.
2. I opened the integration log for the employee, searched the data using the employee ID, and found a string on 28/10/2024, where the reporting manager was already listed.
3. However, that reporting manager is not showing in the employee master, and another manager is listed instead.
4. I went to the user logs menu, searched the module "User Hierarchy" with a filter by employee ID, and found that the reporting manager was changed on 29/10/2024 by Mr. Jignesh Prajapati.
5. The updated reporting manager, as changed by Mr. Jignesh, is now correctly showing in the employee master menu.
solution:

comments:
We took a remote session with the user and found that one employee had resigned, and his card ID was surrendered and reassigned to another employee. However, the user reported that when the new employee punched in, the transaction view still displayed the resigned employee's name.

We performed the following steps to resolve the issue:

We performed the user dump process to check if the card ID was still assigned to the resigned employee. This process re-assigned the card ID to the new employee, but the issue persisted.

We rejoined the employee, reassigned the card ID to him, and then resigned him again by selecting the "card surrender" option. However, the problem remained unresolved.

We deleted the card log entry in the card inventory log using the following query:
DELETE FROM cardinventory_log WHERE cardid='696';

After this, we reassigned the card ID to the new employee and asked Bhim to punch in. The issue was resolved and it is now working as expected.

name: iApp
description_plain: card forgot application Error : Software restrict user to apply for the card forgot application.
comments:
We have encountered an issue with the shift timing application in the software. When a user attempts to apply for a shift starting at 3:00 AM, the software marks it as "Absent" Mark and not allowing for an application . This is due to the 45-minute difference between the start time of the second shift and the applied shift start time.

To resolve this, the user will need to apply for the shift according to the start time of the second shift, which will be marked as "AH-PH" (Absent - Partial Half). After that, the user can then apply for the leave application for the first half of the shift.

description_plain: Employ No: 146814 access denied massage device CP-02 Group ,IP address 172.24.81.204
comments:
1. The client reported that access is not working for employee ID 146814, even though access was applied on that day.
2. I opened the database menu in the software and found that the device has been inactive since June.
3. I discussed the issue with the IT team and guided them to check the network side and ensure the ping is working. The IT team then checked the device parameters and found that the device port was incorrectly configured.
4. The IT team updated the device port, and now the device is showing as active in the database menu. However, there are over 60,000 pending transactions in the device.
5. I suggested they wait for some time to allow the device to clear the pending transactions, after which they should be able to assign access to the employee.
6. After some time, all the pending transactions were cleared, and the new access commands are now being processed successfully.

description_plain: the client wants to reassign the card to the employee and is also experiencing an issue with the iApp download for the employee.
comments:
An employee’s card was initially reported as lost, but later found. The client set the status to "lost," but did not save the change. After accessing the system remotely, we confirmed that the status was not updated to "lost." We then proceeded to surrender the card, reassign it to the employee, and provided local access.

Following this, the employee encountered an issue with downloading the iApp, which displayed an error asking them to "Please connect to HR." We then obtained HR access, sent the necessary link to the employee, and provided the required access.

The next issue was that when the employee punched in, the date and time displayed were incorrect, showing a time five minutes earlier than the actual time. After accessing the device's database, we synced the date and time, resolving the issue.
solution:
An employee’s card was initially reported as lost, but later found. The client set the status to "lost," but did not save the change. After accessing the system remotely, we confirmed that the status was not updated to "lost." We then proceeded to surrender the card, reassign it to the employee, and provided local access.

Following this, the employee encountered an issue with downloading the iApp, which displayed an error asking them to "Please connect to HR." We then obtained HR access, sent the necessary link to the employee, and provided the required access.

The next issue was that when the employee punched in, the date and time displayed were incorrect, showing a time five minutes earlier than the actual time. After accessing the device's database, we synced the date and time, resolving the issue.

5. This is why the week off is showing on 05/11/2024.
6. I shared the data with the client.

ticket_title: Resolution Required: Negative Work Hours in “Door Wise Employee Work Hour Report” Module - [Ticket No - T018526]
description_plain: Dear Spectra Support Team, As per our recent support interaction under Ticket No - T018526, we would like to address an ongoing issue that our client is experiencing with the Spectra iApp Software. The “Door Wise Employee Work Hour Report” is generating negative work hours for employees working night shifts, which has raised significant concerns for our client. As discussed with your team, it was suggested that our client need to switch to the Time Attendance Module. However, our client does not find this solution satisfactory for the following reasons: The report module is titled as a “Door Wise Employee Work Hour Report,” and it includes column labeled “Work Hours.” Based on this labeling, our client reasonably expects the report to provide accurate, positive work hours irrespective of the shift timings. Given the current report’s design, the generation of negative values for night-shift employees implies a software architectural limitation. Our client, therefore, believes this issue should be corrected within the “Door Wise Employee Work Hour Report” module itself. Our observation aligns with the client’s feedback. Since the report is expected to reflect accurate work hours without manual adjustments or workarounds, it appears the current module functionality is insufficient and may require a software update or enhancement from the OEM side. We kindly request a revised solution that ensures the report accurately captures work hours as expected. Please let us know if additional information is required. We look forward to your response and a satisfactory resolution that meets our client's needs. Best
comments:
Following our discussion today and our previous conversations with senior team members, we would like to clarify below points again regarding the ACM (Access Control Module).

The client only utilizes the ACM module. Within this module, each day is standardized to run from 00:00 to 23:59 hours. This accurately captures reports when users register both In and Out punches within a single day.

However, when an employee’s shift spans past midnight (e.g., with an In punch on one day and an Out punch on the next), the system treats these as two separate days due to the absence of shift configuration capabilities in the ACM module.

From a functionality perspective, there is no shortfall in the ACM module itself. However, the client has requested the features, which are configurable from the AMM (Attendance Management Module), in which we may configure shift upto 24:00 hours.

description_plain: Why every time his OT get rejected, Kindly help us to resolve the issue. Employee id 115327(Vijendra Kumar Saini)
comments:
1. The client reported that for employee ID 115327 - Vijendra Kumar Saini, overtime applications are showing as pending in the system and are not appearing in the sanctioning application.
2. I opened the overtime/COFF page, searched for the employee, and found that all the applications are pending in the system.
3. I opened the sanction application page and found that no applications are showing in the approval section.
4. I checked the user hierarchy, selected the overtime hierarchy, and filtered by employee ID. I found that the final approval was not defined for the employee. As per the application sanctioning rule, if the final approval is not defined, overtime applications will remain pending in the system.
5. I advised the client to update the final approval in the overtime hierarchy.
solution:
1. The client reported that for employee ID 115327 - Vijendra Kumar Saini, overtime applications are showing as pending in the system and are not appearing in the sanctioning application.
2. I opened the overtime/COFF page, searched for the employee, and found that all the applications are pending in the system.
3. I opened the sanction application page and found that no applications are showing in the approval section.
4. I checked the user hierarchy, selected the overtime hierarchy, and filtered by employee ID. I found that the final approval was not defined for the employee. As per the application sanctioning rule, if the final approval is not defined, overtime applications will remain pending in the system.
5. I advised the client to update the final approval in the overtime hierarchy.

description_plain: Employee id 146958 overtime showing pending at system.
comments:
1. The client reported that overtime applications for employee ID 146958 are showing as pending in the system for Diwali holidays.
2. I opened the overtime/COFF page and confirmed that the employee’s applications are marked as pending for the Diwali holiday.
3. I checked the attendance sheet and saw that the employee worked during the shift hours. I then reviewed the attendance policy and found that extra hours worked on holidays are eligible for overtime within the shift.
4. I accessed the user hierarchy and selected the overtime hierarchy, filtering by employee ID. I found that the final approval had already been received in the system, which is why all the applications are marked as pending.
5. I advised the client to update the final approval in the system to resolve the issue.
solution:

description_plain: It is high time for urgent attention. Since this morning, we have been following up with the Spectra team, but the attendance punch data has still not been downloaded across Zydus. This issue is severely impacting our production planning, daily attendance reports, manpower planning, and more. Please provide an estimated time for resolution as soon as possible.
comments:
1. The client reported that the attendance data for all employees has not been showing in the spreadsheet for the past 2 days.  
2. I opened the attendance sheet, checked multiple employees, and found that the data was missing.  
3. I checked other locations as well and found that no data has been reflected in the system across all Zydus locations for the past 2 days.  
4. I accessed the Zydus server, opened the database page, and executed the following query:  
   `Select * from trans(Nolock) where PunchDetail Between '2024-11-12 15:00:01' and '2024-11-13 23:59:59' Order By Updatedon DESC`  
5. I found that transactions are clearing very slowly, with only 2-3 transactions being cleared per minute. I discussed this with the internal team and escalated the issue to the development team due to the large backlog of pending transactions.  
6. Mr. Prashant from the development team has assisted in resolving this issue, and transactions are now clearing properly. As of now, 80,000 transactions have been cleared.  
7. I opened the attendance sheet again, and the transactions are now showing. We are now waiting for client confirmation.
solution: Now all pending transactions are cleared, and the attendance data is showing properly in the spreadsheet.

description_plain: Attendance not showing in iapp
comments:
We conducted a remote session with the user and found that employee P0039 had punched in on the Face Scribe device. The user claimed that the "Access Allowed" message was displayed at that time.

However, we observed that the punches for 8th, 9th, and 11th November are not reflecting in the Miscellaneous section, although punches after the 11th are appearing correctly. Further investigation revealed that no records for the mentioned employee code or card ID were found in the transaction view for the missing dates.

Upon checking the Face Portal control logs, we noticed that the missing punches were recorded, but they were associated with a different card ID. We cross-checked the status of this card ID in the card inventory and found that it was assigned to the same employee, but under a different employee code.

The client later confirmed that they had registered all employees with new employee codes, new card IDs, and newly registered faces. After the new face registration, punches were being recorded under the new employee code, while punches for the missing dates were showing under the old card ID. This was confirmed by reviewing the transaction view and control logs in the Face Portal.

To prevent this issue from occurring in the future, we have suggested to the client that they surrender all old card IDs.

For now, we will be closing this ticket, and we recommend that the client proceed with the suggested action.

description_plain: Overtime hours of Mr. Aniket Dabhade (147960) of previous month has not got approved. As it is showing as pending from system. Hence requesting you to grant his overtime for the month of October. Please refer the OT details in the below screen shot and do the needful.
comments:
1. The client reported that overtime applications were pending in the system. I opened the overtime/COFF applications and found several applications were marked as pending for employee ID 147960.
2. Upon checking the user logs, I discovered that the overtime hierarchy had been changed in the system, which caused the applications to be pending.
3. I accessed the Zydus server and executed the following query:  
   ```sql
   SELECT * FROM adjustapply (nolock) WHERE category='Overtime' AND SendAppTo='-10' AND laststatus IN ('P', 'U') AND f7=1 AND attddate BETWEEN '2024-09-26' AND '2024-11-14' 
   UPDATE adjustapply SET f7 = NULL WHERE category='Overtime' AND SendAppTo='-10' AND laststatus IN ('P', 'U') AND f7=1 AND attddate BETWEEN '2024-09-26' AND '2024-11-14' 
4. I waited for the pending applications process to complete, and then reprocessed the overtime applications. Now, all the applications are showing correctly in the system.

name: NetXsControl Ent.
description_plain: Card id issue
comments:
We took a remote session on the user's system and found that there were two issues. First, an employee who had left the organization was still showing as 'punching' in the download report. Upon investigation, we discovered that the employee's release date had not been entered, which allowed the user to continue punching in with the same card ID. We guided the user to enter the release date for the card ID, after which the employee would no longer be able to punch.

The second issue was that some card IDs, which no longer existed in the software, were still reflecting in the download report. After discussing internally, we found that this issue had occurred previously and the resolution required replacing the software, download executable, and STX control DLL. After replacing the necessary files, we tried to restart the downloading process, but encountered a 'VFlag column error,' which indicated that we needed to add a new column to the MDB database.

We installed SQL DBX, established the ODBC connection, and attempted to create the new column. However, we encountered a '42000' error. We then took the database to our system and tried to create the new column there, but the issue persisted. We informed the user that we would need to discuss the matter with the development team, and in the meantime, we replaced the old executable and DLL files to continue the current process.

ticket_title: Negative Work Hours in “Door Wise Employee Work Hour Report” Module
description_plain: The “Door Wise Employee Work Hour Report” is generating negative work hours for employees working night shifts, which has raised significant concerns for our client. As discussed with your team, it was suggested that our client need to switch to the Time Attendance Module. However, our client does not find this solution satisfactory for the following reasons: The report module is titled as a “Door Wise Employee Work Hour Report,” and it includes column labeled “Work Hours.” Based on this labeling, our client reasonably expects the report to provide accurate, positive work hours irrespective of the shift timings. Given the current report’s design, the generation of negative values for night-shift employees implies a software architectural limitation. Our client, therefore, believes this issue should be corrected within the “Door Wise Employee Work Hour Report” module itself. Our observation aligns with the client’s feedback. Since the report is expected to reflect accurate work hours without manual adjustments or workarounds, it appears the current module functionality is insufficient and may require a software update or enhancement from the OEM side. We kindly request a revised solution that ensures the report accurately captures work hours as expected. Please let us know if additional information is required. We look forward to your response and a satisfactory resolution that meets our client's needs.
comments:
The client only utilizes the ACM module. Within this module, each day is standardized to run from 00:00 to 23:59 hours. This accurately captures reports when users register both In and Out punches within a single day.

However, when an employee’s shift spans past midnight (e.g., with an In punch on one day and an Out punch on the next), the system treats these as two separate days due to the absence of shift configuration capabilities in the ACM module.

From a functionality perspective, there is no shortfall in the ACM module itself. However, the client has requested the features, which are configurable from the AMM (Attendance Management Module), in which we may configure shift upto 24:00 hours.


Reference - Prakash's email on 11-11-2024, 16:46
solution: OEM recommended use Time Attendance Module

Please find the necessary snapshots attached for your reference, and let us know if you require any further assistance from our side.

description_plain: Employee’s O.T show till date pending at system need to change actual O.T approver.
comments:
1. The client reported that although the overtime hierarchy final approval has been changed, the overtime applications are still showing as pending in the system. 
2. To address this issue, I accessed the Zydus server and executed the following query to clear all pending OT applications: 
SELECT * FROM adjustapply (nolock) WHERE category='Overtime' AND SendAppTo='-10' AND laststatus IN('P','U') AND f7=1 AND attddate BETWEEN '2024-09-26' AND '2024-11-14' 
UPDATE adjustapply SET f7 = NULL WHERE category='Overtime' AND SendAppTo='-10' AND laststatus IN('P','U') AND f7=1 AND attddate BETWEEN '2024-09-26' AND '2024-11-14'  
3. After executing the update and allowing some time for processing, all the OT applications were successfully cleared. 
4. Now Pending OT has been cleared and OT is showing pending at respective approval.

3. I opened the software and performed a factory reset on the device, then set the card format.
4. I started the user dump activity on the device and waited for some time until it completed.
5. After the process was completed, the device punch is working fine, and data is showing in the downloading field.

name: iApp
description_plain: License Issue live person below 700
comments:
We took a remote session with the user and found that the user has a license for 700 employees, of which 671 are active, 25 have resigned, 2 are relieved, and 10 employees are blocked. The system should allow the user to add new employees, but when trying to add a new employee, it is showing a "License limit exceeded" error.

Upon investigation, we understood that in the Employee Master, if an employee has a "Resigned" status, they are still holding the policy. Therefore, until the status is changed to "Relieved" and the card ID is set to 0000, the count will remain in the license summary.

To resolve this, we rejoined the employee and tried to surrender the card ID, but the submit button in the Card Inventory was not clickable. Additionally, in the Employee Master, the user encountered an "Ajax Request failed" message, possibly due to a session expiration.

As a final attempt, we resigned the employee again and selected the "Card Surrender" checkbox, but the card ID is still showing as active.

We have since updated to the latest version of iApp, as discussed with Abhishek. This issue was previously addressed by Mr. Suresh, who recommended updating to the latest core version 4.1.77.0.
solution:
We took a remote session with the user and found that a license error was occurring while assigning a policy to a new employee. Upon investigation, we discovered that the resigned employee's card was not being surrendered, which prevented the license from being freed up.

We checked the log files by rejoining and resigning an employee and found a site code error. Further investigation revealed that the Site Code column was missing in the Employee Master table, although it was present in the All User table.

We concluded that this caused the issue. To resolve it, we added the missing column in the Employee Master table and refreshed the records. Now, the card has been surrendered, and the license count is showing the remaining employees, as confirmed by us.

name: iApp
description_plain: Installation Face Machine
comments:
We took a remote session with the user and learned that they want to configure a new FaceScribe Plus device in iApp for the Dahej location. To do this, we asked the user to open the network settings on the device by entering the password "ADMIN" and provide the device's IP address from their network range.

After that, we accessed FacePortal using the device's IP and changed the necessary fields such as Server IP, port, and device configuration to match the working device.

Once the details were updated on the FaceScribe, we added the new device in iApp by following these steps:

iApp > Attendance Management > Device Management > Device > Add > Save
After adding the device, we synchronized the user data to the newly added device by performing the following steps:

iApp > Attendance Management > Device Management > Device Operation > Database > Select Device > Sync User > Save
The device is now online, and the user has confirmed its functionality by punching on the device.

name: iApp
description_plain: Still Issue not resolved. Again other location devices asking for Finger Required. Please look into matter on immediate basis. Emp No-112035, 42594,108133
comments:
1. I discussed with the client, and we checked the PTC devices at the local location and found that the Disable Finger Authentication is working fine.
2. After that, I need to check the devices at other global locations, but the client is unable to check the devices at other locations right now, so he will perform this activity tomorrow.
solution:
1. The employee visited the plant at Zydus Corporate Park. I had a conference call with the client and started the activity as the client was punching in. However, an error appeared stating "finger timeout," and it was found that the finger authentication had already been disabled for that employee.  
2. I then removed the finger authentication for the employee, went to the assign access page, and reassigned local and global access for that employee.  
3. Despite this, the same error occurred when the employee tried to use the card punch on the device, with "finger required" still showing on the device.  
4. I discussed the case with Setul sir, and he suggested setting up a rule for that particular employee's authentication mode for all the global devices.

       empcode varchar(50) NULL,
       Punchdate Date NULL,
       Punchtime Datetime NULL,
       ID int IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL,
       is_drawing_sync tinyint NOT NULL,
       PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED (ID)
   );
   ```  
6. Now that the table was created, I went to the DB path and created a new DB path for the software.  
7. The task is now completed, and I checked with the client. The data is being fetched properly in the system.

description_plain: Team, Please help me to know how to set the pin for employee access. WE ARE GREAT PLACE TO WORK – CERTIFIED ™ Deepak Nandakumar | Senior Executive – Admin & Facilities Softtek India Private Limited | Shilpa Emerald, No.26/1 | Next to IBIS Hotel | Hosur Main Road | Bangalore, 560068, Karnataka, India Ph: (+91) 40165000 | Mobile: +91 9880437755 | www.softtek.com @Softtek Softtek Linkedin Softtek Facebook Softtek Blog SofttekTV
comments: User will connect at their convenience time to provide remote.
solution:
We took a remote session with the user and found that the user had configured an exception for the employee, where devices are configured as Card+Finger, but for some employees, they wanted to configure the Card+PIN module.

We checked and found that the exception is working fine for one employee, but not for the others. After troubleshooting, we identified the following solution for the issue:

iApp > Access Control > Workflow > Exception > Change Authentication Mode > Select Employee > Select Device > Change Mode (Card+PIN) > Save.
Punch the card on the device; it will ask for a PIN. Enter the default PIN 0000 and press enter.
Now, it will prompt you to enter a new password.
By applying the steps mentioned, the reported issue has been resolved

name: iApp
description_plain: client have shift related issue
comments: Not under AMC
solution:
Kindly follow the procedure outlined below for managing a 24-hour shift schedule.

First Shift (08:00 AM to 20:00 PM):

    The maximum allowed work hours have been set to 12 hours and 20 minutes, as discussed.
    The application will calculate work hours from the shift start time or the employee's first punch of the day.
    If the employee’s work hours exceed the 12-hour 20-minute limit, their punch will be shifted to the next day.

Example:

    If the first punch is at 08:15 AM and the second punch is at 20:19 PM, it will work fine. However, if the employee works beyond the defined shift time, they must punch in again after 20:21 PM for the system to properly record the attendance, as per the 12:20 max hours limit.

Second Shift (20:00 PM to 08:00 AM):

    The maximum allowed work hours for the second shift are also defined as 12 hours and 20 minutes.

Example:

    If the first punch is at 20:15 PM and the next punch is at 08:19 AM, it will work fine. If the employee needs to continue working across both shifts, they must punch in after 08:19 AM, in line with the 12:20 max hour configuration.

Important Notes:

    Two Punches Required: To calculate the total work hours within the first shift, two punches are mandatory. A miss punch or single punch is not allowed for automatic shift calculations.
    Shift Continuation: If the shift continues, there should not be any missed punches or single punches. For an employee to continue working on the same day, at least two punches are required.

description_plain: Please delete Auto Approve late hours application on date 28/09/2024.
comments:
1. I opening the attendance sheet, we noticed that the shift information was incorrect. When attempting to apply for a shift change, a message indicated that late permission had already been approved for that day. 
2. Despite trying to delete the late permission, the same message persisted. 
3. To address this, we accessed the Zydus database and executed the following queries: 
Select * from empmaster where code='43878' 
SELECT * FROM adjustapply(nolock) WHERE userid='25890' AND attddate='2024/09/28' AND category = 'Late'; 
Delete FROM adjustapply(nolock) WHERE userid='25890' AND attddate='2024/09/28' AND category = 'Late'; 
4.After removing the late permission, we redirected to the attendance page. However, the same error persisted when attempting to change the shift. To resolve this, we executed the following query to set the early flag to NULL mode: 
Select * from attdmain where empid='25890' and attddate='2024/09/28' 
5. With this adjustment, the employee was able to change the shift as needed.

name: iApp
description_plain: Please deleted late coming application on date 11/11/2024. employee id 83558 I cant able to delete it.
comments:
1. I opening the attendance sheet, we noticed that the shift information was incorrect. When attempting to apply for a shift change, a message indicated that late permission had already been approved for that day. 
2. Despite trying to delete the late permission, the same message persisted. 
3. To address this, we accessed the Zydus database and executed the following queries: 
Select * from empmaster where code='83558' 
SELECT * FROM adjustapply(nolock) WHERE userid='' AND attddate='2024/11/11' AND category = 'Late'; 
Delete FROM adjustapply(nolock) WHERE userid='' AND attddate='2024/11/11' AND category = 'Late'; 
4.After removing the late permission, we redirected to the attendance page. However, the same error persisted when attempting to change the shift. To resolve this, we executed the following query to set the early flag to NULL mode: 
Select * from attdmain where empid='83558' and attddate='2024/11/11' 5. With this adjustment, the employee was able to change the shift as needed.
solution:
1. I opening the attendance sheet, we noticed that the shift information was incorrect. When attempting to apply for a shift change, a message indicated that late permission had already been approved for that day. 
2. Despite trying to delete the late permission, the same message persisted. 
3. To address this, we accessed the Zydus database and executed the following queries: 
Select * from empmaster where code='83558' 
SELECT * FROM adjustapply(nolock) WHERE userid='' AND attddate='2024/11/11' AND category = 'Late'; 
Delete FROM adjustapply(nolock) WHERE userid='' AND attddate='2024/11/11' AND category = 'Late'; 
4.After removing the late permission, we redirected to the attendance page. However, the same error persisted when attempting to change the shift. To resolve this, we executed the following query to set the early flag to NULL mode: 
Select * from attdmain where empid='83558' and attddate='2024/11/11' 5. With this adjustment, the employee was able to change the shift as needed.

ticket_title: License error while adding new employee
description_plain: License error while adding new employee
comments: Need to forward to QC.
solution:
We took a remote session with the user and found that a license error was occurring while assigning a policy to a new employee. Upon investigation, we discovered that the resigned employee's card was not being surrendered, which prevented the license from being freed up.

We checked the log files by rejoining and resigning an employee and found a site code error. Further investigation revealed that the Site Code column was missing in the Employee Master table, although it was present in the All User table.

We concluded that this caused the issue. To resolve it, we added the missing column in the Employee Master table and refreshed the records. Now, the card has been surrendered, and the license count is showing the remaining employees, as confirmed by us.

name: iApp
description_plain: Mr. Biswajit(130196) has got his 5 C-Offs approved, however in leave balance its showing only 3 C-Offs. Kindly do needful. Refer below screenshots for reference.
comments:
1. The client reported that employee ID 130196 has done overtime and the COFF was successfully generated, but when we check the COFF balance, it shows 3, which is incorrect because the actual COFF balance should be 5.
2. I opened the attendance sheet and found that only one overtime application is showing as pending right now.
3. I checked the COFF balance, and currently, it is showing only 1.
4. I opened the sanction application page, searched for the employee, and found only 3-4 overtime applications for the months of November and October, so I need to discuss this with the client for better understanding.
solution:
1. Opening the attendance sheet, we found that overtime application had already been approved, but the coff count was showing as zero. 
2. I discovering the bug, we immediately solved the issue due to the pending payroll process. 
3. Therefore, I cancelled the overtime application in the attendance sheet. 
4. To check the application status, we executed the following query: 
SELECT * FROM EmpMaster WHERE Code='130196' 
SELECT * FROM adjustapply(nolock) WHERE userid='56122' AND attddate='2024/11/01' AND category = 'Overtime'; 
5. The last status for the application was showing as 'G', so we updated it as 'P'. 
6. Upon reprocessing the attendance sheet, the application was now showing as pending at the approver. 
7. Having approved the application from the sanction list, the coff count now showed properly.

comments:
1. The client reported that DB-related activities are needed for the Anand Zydus Hospital location.
2. I opened the database and found that the DB was already created as "Employee DB" and the table was set up, but SQL Express was showing as "stopped" in the services.
3. I tried multiple times to start the service, but an error related to Windows was showing.
4. I suggested to the client to check with their IT team, and the IT team checked but couldn't find any resolution.
5. I guided them to restart the system and check again. The client restarted the system and waited for it to boot up.
6. After the system started, I opened SQL, entered the SQL credentials, and SQL opened successfully with the service showing as "started."
7. I executed the following query:
   `Select * from EmployeePunch`
8. I found that all the transactions were showing successfully, so I guided the user, and the DB setup was completed successfully.
solution:

4. I suggested to the client to check with their IT team, and the IT team checked but couldn't find any resolution.
5. I guided them to restart the system and check again. The client restarted the system and waited for it to boot up.
6. After the system started, I opened SQL, entered the SQL credentials, and SQL opened successfully with the service showing as "started."

name: iApp
description_plain: Need urgent support for payroll month closure process.
comments:
1. I have been working on this task from 8:00 AM this morning from home. The client started the month closure process, but when it was completed, it restarted again with the same process. Only one location took time to complete the process 2-3 times, so I had to access the Zydus server and cancel the process from the database using the following query:
   `Select * from Machinedata where commandType LIKE '%Payroll%' and Status='P'`  
2. After canceling the process, the client was able to start the process for other locations.   
3. I performed this same process for all 40 locations. After the process was completed, the client needed a list of completed locations for the payroll. I executed the following query to generate the list:
   `SELECT l.name, M.ExecuteDate FROM MachineData m (nolock) JOIN Location l ON m.locationid = l.id WHERE m.Status = 'S' AND m.CommandType LIKE '%Payroll%'`
4. I found the list of locations where the month closure was completed and shared the file with the client.
solution: I shared the file with the client, and as per the client's confirmation, the file is correct, and the month-end closure process for all locations has been completed.

name: SCM-NetServer Comm
description_plain: Create a new database and DB path for Baroda Zydus Hospital.
comments: I need to create a new database for the Employee DB transactions, so I took remote access and opened SQL, but the credentials were not available from the IT team. I then went to the software file location and tried to decrypt the path file, but I couldn't find any SQL credentials details. Therefore, I requested the client to locate the SQL credentials.
solution:
1. The client's requirement is to create a different database for employee transactions, so I requested them to provide me with remote access. 
2. After some time, the client provided me with remote access, so I opened SQL in SQL authentication mode, and SQL opened correctly. 
3. I went to the database and created a new database called "Employee DB." Then, I went to the tables and created a new table called "EmployeePunch" with the following columns: - 
EmployeePunch varchar(50) NULL, 
- empcode date NULL, 
- Punchdate date NULL, 
- Punchtime datetime NULL, 
- ID int NULL, 
- is_drawing_sync tinyint NULL. 
4. After saving the information, the table was created successfully. Then, I went to the software and created the DB path for the software. I returned to SQL and executed the following query: 
`Select * from EmployeePunch` 
5. Now, all the transactions are showing correctly.

name: iApp
description_plain: Please delete late permission of Mr Mandeep Kumar Sharma having emp.code-148032 dated 08.11.2024.
comments:
1. I opening the attendance sheet, we noticed that the shift information was incorrect. When attempting to apply for a shift change, a message indicated that late permission had already been approved for that day. 
2. Despite trying to delete the late permission, the same message persisted. 
3. To address this, we accessed the Zydus database and executed the following queries: 
Select * from empmaster where code='148032' 
SELECT * FROM adjustapply(nolock) WHERE userid='' AND attddate='2024/11/08' AND category = 'Late'; 
Delete FROM adjustapply(nolock) WHERE userid='' AND attddate='2024/11/08' AND category = 'Late'; 
4.After removing the late permission, we redirected to the attendance page. However, the same error persisted when attempting to change the shift. To resolve this, we executed the following query to set the early flag to NULL mode: 
Select * from attdmain where empid='148032' and attddate='2024/11/08' 
5. With this adjustment, the employee was able to change the shift as needed.

description_plain: Please delete late hours (Auto Perm) on dated 23/11/2024. Employee No: 104359 - Ranveer Singh Kindly help to delete Auto Perm-23/11/24. We are unable to update his punches of 22/11/24
comments:
1. We opening the attendance sheet, we noticed that the shift information was incorrect. When attempting to update the attendance punch, a message indicated that late permission had already been approved for the day. 
2. Despite trying to delete the late permission, the same message persisted. 
3. To address this, we accessed the Zydus database and executed the following queries: 
Select * from empmaster where code='104359' 
SELECT * FROM adjustapply(nolock) WHERE userid='1617' AND attddate='2024/11/23' AND category = 'Late'; 
4.After removing the late permission, we redirected to the attendance page. However, the same error persisted when attempting to update the punch. 50 To resolve this, we executed the following query to set the early flag to NULL mode: 
Select * from attdmain where empid='104359' and attddate='2024/11/23' 
5. With this adjustment, the client was able to update the punch.

name: iApp
description_plain: Please check the devices due to some employee in time data missing. Please do the needful urgent basis. PFA photo. With IP address for your reference.
comments: I emailed the client asking them to share some examples so I can check from here as well.
solution:
1. The client reported that employee in/out punches on the turnstile are not showing in the software, and only "out" punches are appearing.  
2. I opened the employee master and went to the miscellaneous menu, where I found that only "out" punches were recorded for the date 25.10.2024.  
3. I then opened the database menu and confirmed that the device was showing as active.  
4. I accessed the Zydus server, went to the services menu, and opened the data log for that day. I copied all the log files and extracted them using the log extractor.  
5. I filtered the data by card ID and found that the turnstile data was present in the log file, indicating that the data was not successfully read by the software.  
6. I opened the log file and discovered that the MAC address was incorrect. I replaced all the duplicate MAC addresses with the correct MAC address and saved the file.  
7. I created a folder called "Recover" in the services directory and restarted the Spectra worker service. After the restart, the log file was successfully read by the system.  
8. I refreshed the software page, and now the transactions are showing correctly.

description_plain: Turnstile-2 Exit Baddi are shown shut down in to system.
comments:
1. The client reported that the Turnstile Exit 2 device is not working properly and is showing as inactive in the system.  
2. I checked the database page in the software and found that the device is indeed showing as inactive.  
3. I accessed the Zydus server and pinged the device IP, but the device IP was not consistently pinging, and sometimes it showed a timeout. This suggests that the device was restarting intermittently, which is why the commands were not being executed properly.  
4. I executed the following queries to check if the machine data was cleared:  
   - `SELECT * FROM controllermaster WHERE ipaddr='192.168.5.95'`  
   - `SELECT * FROM machinedata WHERE controllerid='807' AND status='P'`  
5. I found that the device's machine data was not cleared, and the commands were being processed very slowly. This also indicated a potential hardware issue.  
6. Since the client's hardware is not under AMC, I have transferred this case to the AMC team for further investigation.
solution:
1. The client reported that Turnstile 2 Exit Baddi was not working, and the device was unresponsive.  
2. I checked the system and found that the device was showing as inactive. I then accessed the Zydus server and checked the device's IP but found that it was not pinging on the server.  
3. I connected with the IT team, and they investigated the issue on their end. They found a network-related problem, which was resolved after some time. Once the device's IP was live, it started showing as active.  
4. I updated the device firmware and initiated the user dump process, then waited for it to complete.  
5. After the process was completed, the device started working fine.

description_plain: Please check below employee Attendance. System tack auto permit but 0.5 Absent show in system. Employee No: 120429 - Solanki Virpalsinh Date: 18/11/2024
comments:
1. The client reported that an employee was late by 98 minutes on 18/11/2024, and the auto-late permission was already applied on that day, but the employee is still showing as absent.  
2. I checked the attendance page and found that the late hours were not showing for that day, which is why the employee is marked as half-day absent.  
3. I accessed the Zydus server and executed the following queries:  
   - `SELECT * FROM EmpMaster WHERE Code='120429'`  
   - `SELECT * FROM adjustapply(nolock) WHERE userid='25120' AND attddate='2024/11/18' AND category = 'late';`  
   - `DELETE FROM adjustapply WHERE userid='25120' AND attddate='2024/11/18' AND category = 'late';`  
4. After deleting the late permission, the flag was still showing in the attendance sheet, so I proceeded to delete the permission from the `attdmain` table by executing the following query:  
   - `SELECT * FROM attdmain WHERE userid='25120' AND attddate='2024/11/18';`  
5. I updated the late permission flag to NULL, removing the late permission from the attendance record.  
6. I reprocessed the attendance for that day, and the late hours began displaying correctly. Then, I reapplied the late permission for that day.  
7. After reapplying the late permission, the employee is now showing as present for that day.

description_plain: No employee can punch in and out kindly arrange support ASAP.
comments:
We took a remote session with the user and found that no employee was able to punch on the FaceScribe device, and it is showing as 'stranger' for them.

solution: The client's issue was that they were not getting attendance when they punched in using the ARS Win software. So, we took remote access and checked the system. We discovered that the data was not transferring from Commsoft to ARS Win due to a mismatch in the card IDs. We also noticed that the face portal configurations were different, so we changed the setting from decimal to hexadecimal and adjusted the bit pattern. After that, we had the client punch in at all the units, and then we initiated the download. This allowed all the previous data to be recovered, as it had been stuck before. After the configuration changes, the issue was resolved.

ticket_title: Error issue occurred during attendance checking.
description_plain: Error issue occurred during attendance checking.
comments:
We took remote session of the user and found that when user try to open attendance sheet in date wise it is showing error.
We checked and found that it is happening due to when user create a new shift in database duplicate entry is showing in shift master table.
To resolve this issue  we has perform below queries.
select * from ShiftMaster order by id
select * from UserMaster where UserName='administrator'
select * from Sequences where TypeOfTrans='shiftmaster'
select * into Sequences_02122024 from Sequences
select *  from usersettings where id='1' and category in('Sorting','Filtering')
update Sequences set LastSequence='44' where TypeOfTrans='shiftmaster'

After performing the queries reported issue has been resolved.

name: iApp
description_plain: The client reported that the item price for Biologics, VTC, and Vtech locations is showing incorrectly in the report for all employees.
comments:
1. The client reported that when they try to generate the canteen report for VTC, Vtech, and Fill Finish locations, it shows the old prices for lunch and dinner, and the new prices have not been updated in the system since 01/11/2024.
2. First, I checked the device status, and it was showing as active. Then, I went to the item master and found that the item prices were already updated in the software.
3. I accessed the Zydus server and executed the following query:  
   `Select * from scheduledprocess(nolock) where status='Pending' and Eventname Like '%Canteen%'`
4. I found two entries that were stuck and not cleared, which is why the old prices were showing. Additionally, 202 records were showing as pending, so I updated the pending records flag to 'xpending' using the following query:  
   `Update scheduledprocess set status='pending' where status='xpending' and eventname not like '%Canteen%'`
5. After waiting for some time, the two stuck canteen records were cleared, and now the item prices are showing correctly in the system.
solution:
1. The client reported that when they try to generate the canteen report for VTC, Vtech, and Fill Finish locations, it shows the old prices for lunch and dinner, and the new prices have not been updated in the system since 01/11/2024.

description_plain: Duplicate entry of visitors showing in front desk.
comments:
1. The client reported that duplicate entries are generated in the VMS front desk menu. For instance, if we register 1 visitor, then 200 duplicate entries are automatically generated for the same visitor with a "-10000000" visit ID. 
2. I opened the front desk menu and filtered the date from July 1, 2024, to Dec, 2024, and found more than 200 duplicate entries for all Zydus locations. 3. To resolve this issue, I took the Zydus server database and first backed up all visitor data with the following query: 
Select * into Visitor_03122024 from Visitor 
4. After taking the backup, I executed the following query to identify "-1" entries with different location IDs: 
Select * from Location 
Select * from Visitor(Nolock) where locationid='6' and Visitid='0000000000-1' 
5. I found numerous duplicate entries location-wise and proceeded to delete them one by one using the following query: Delete from Visitor where id='666167' 
6. After removing all duplicate entries from the system, no additional duplicate entries are showing in the front desk menu.

description_plain: Pls check below details employee can’t punch in Admin block only read light blinking. Employee id 36355
comments:
1. The client reported that access is not working for employee ID 36355.  
2. I went to the "Assign Access" menu and attempted to assign access to the employee, but the command was not going through, showing as "waiting," and automatically timing out from the page.  
3. I checked the Zydus database and found that CPU consumption was very high, and the server was not functioning properly.  
4. I executed the following query to check CPU consumption:  
   
   ```sql
   SELECT r.cpu_time AS cpu, s.login_name,
   DATEDIFF(SECOND, last_request_start_time, getdate()) AS Seconds,
   s.session_id AS SessionID, blocking_session_id AS Blocking,
   SUBSTRING( st.text, (statement_start_offset/2)+1,
   ABS(((CASE statement_end_offset WHEN -1 THEN DATALENGTH(st.text)
   ELSE statement_end_offset
   END - statement_start_offset)/2) + 1 )) AS statement_text,
   OBJECT_SCHEMA_NAME (objectid , r.database_id ) as SchemaName
   FROM sys.dm_exec_requests r
   INNER JOIN sys.dm_exec_sessions s ON s.session_id = r.session_id
   CROSS APPLY sys.dm_exec_sql_text(sql_handle) AS st
   ORDER BY Seconds DESC
   ```  
5. I did not find any high CPU consumption, so I went to the services, stopped the Spectra worker service, and then stopped the IIS server.  
6. After some time, I started the services and IIS again, but the issue persisted. I discussed it with Setul Sir, and he checked from his side.  
7. Now the server is working fine, and the access command is going through successfully.
