name: iApp
description_plain: The admin block device is showing "user not found," and access has already been assigned to the employees.
comments:
1. The client reported that access is not working for employee ID 36355.  
2. I went to the "Assign Access" menu and attempted to assign access to the employee, but the command was not going through, showing as "waiting," and automatically timing out from the page.  
3. I checked the Zydus database and found that CPU consumption was very high, and the server was not functioning properly.  
4. I executed the following query to check CPU consumption:  
   
   ```sql
   SELECT r.cpu_time AS cpu, s.login_name,
   DATEDIFF(SECOND, last_request_start_time, getdate()) AS Seconds,
   s.session_id AS SessionID, blocking_session_id AS Blocking,
   SUBSTRING( st.text, (statement_start_offset/2)+1,
   ABS(((CASE statement_end_offset WHEN -1 THEN DATALENGTH(st.text)
   ELSE statement_end_offset
   END - statement_start_offset)/2) + 1 )) AS statement_text,
   OBJECT_SCHEMA_NAME (objectid , r.database_id ) as SchemaName
   FROM sys.dm_exec_requests r
   INNER JOIN sys.dm_exec_sessions s ON s.session_id = r.session_id
   CROSS APPLY sys.dm_exec_sql_text(sql_handle) AS st
   ORDER BY Seconds DESC
   ```  
5. I did not find any high CPU consumption, so I went to the services, stopped the Spectra worker service, and then stopped the IIS server.  
6. After some time, I started the services and IIS again, but the issue persisted. I discussed it with Setul Sir, and he checked from his side.  
7. Now the server is working fine, and the access command is going through successfully.

description_plain: As our canteen punching machine is not working properly we have installed new punching machine. details of the new machine is as mention below. Model No- Spectra 3S IP Address:-1921001009 Requesting you to please sync the data of the existing machine into new machine on top priority.
comments:
1. The client reported that the canteen device is not functioning properly and needs to be replaced urgently.
2. I opened the database menu in the software and found that the device is showing as inactive.
3. I took the Zydus server and pinged the device IP, which showed as active.
4. I opened the bootloader application, selected the 3S device, searched for the device, and found it. I then configured the device parameters and updated the firmware of the canteen device.
5. I opened the software, went to the devices menu, added the new device, and saved the device parameters. The command was successful.
6. After that, I went to the operations menu and performed a factory reset on the device.

name: iApp
ticket_title: User not found and device related issue
description_plain: 1. Frequently user not found error occurred in access system. 2. Some people not access more than 4 to 5 devices. 3 Provide health check-up report of access device. 4. New facility 2nos device was installed but only 1 device show in system. 5. Today we received another compliant from BVP DSP-1 area the system show user not found ( this is repeated and in different device).
comments:
1. The client reported that when the user tries to punch on the device, a "user not found" error appears on the device.
2. I requested them to provide remote access so I could check from here as well.
3. After receiving remote access, I first opened the software and checked the NetXSDownloading, which was showing as stopped. I then started the NetXSDownloading.exe.
4. The Synchronizer.exe was not working, so I navigated to the file location of the software and started the Synchronizer.exe.
5. I checked the controller utility, selected all the controllers, and got the status of each controller. I found that many controllers had pending transaction downloads, and several controllers were showing as inactive in the system.
6. I selected the controller in NetXSDownloading with pending transactions and waited for some time to clear all the pending transactions.
7. After that, I assigned access to the employee and instructed the client to have the user punch on the controller. The punch is now working fine.
8. I checked with 2-3 employees, and the punch is working fine. I also guided them to please not close the Synchronizer and NetXSDownloading executables.
solution:
1. I connected with the client via remote access and also connected with Mr. Nitin Vala from the hardware team to check the issue.  
2. Mr. Nitin Vala provided me with multiple firmware versions, which we updated on the device, but the same issue was still present on the device display.  
3. Our hardware engineer also visited the location and checked the issue. He found that the same issue was occurring on multiple devices, where the employee name was not showing on the display.  
4. I then checked the NetXsControl executable and found it was outdated, so I received the latest version from the development team and started the process to update the executable.  
5. I connected with the IT team and transferred the latest NetXsControl setup, but it wasn’t showing due to domain restrictions when the IT team tried to download the setup.  
6. The IT team provided me with an alternative email ID, and I uploaded the setup via WeTransfer and sent the link to the IT team.  
7. The IT team was then able to download the setup and place it on the system, so I began the software update process.  
8. I updated the NetXsControl, NetXsDownloading, UDF.dll, and Synchronizer executables, then started the software.  
9. I discussed with the client, and he provided me with a list of 10 employees for whom the punching was not working. I edited and saved their details, then checked the access.  
10. I also confirmed with the client, and the concern has been resolved. I took the case under observation for some time, and now the concern has been fully resolved.

name: iApp
description_plain: Please Configuration the Biometric Machine in the 2 Laptop on priority basis and let me know if any details are required from our side.
comments:
1. The client reported that they need to install BioMini finger access on two systems. So, I first checked with the IT team to confirm if the BioMini setup was available.  
2. The BioMini setup was not available, so I logged into OneDrive, uploaded the setup, and created the link for the BioMini.  
3. I shared the link with the client and guided them to download the setup to their system.
solution:
1. The same issue persists: one drive link is not opening from the client’s side due to security restrictions.
2. I requested that they share a TeamViewer remote session so I could assist with the BioMini setup remotely.
3. The IT team shared their TeamViewer credentials, and I was able to share the BioMini setup. However, I was informed that Teams login was required to perform this activity, as TeamViewer is not allowed on the local network from the client’s side.
4. I waited for some time to receive the Teams remote access, but as the client was unable to share it, I discussed the issue with the IT team. They asked me to guide them through the BioMini installation process.
5. I provided the following installation steps to the IT team and guided them through the process:
-->. First, install the Spectra Client service using administrator credentials. Proceed with the installation by clicking directly.
-->. Next, install the Suprema BioMini Plus2 driver on the system. After installation, check the Control Panel to ensure both the Spectra Client service and the Suprema drivers are visible.
-->. Navigate to the Spectra Client folder, copy all files, and paste them into the following path:  
   `C:\Program Files (x86)\Spectra\Spectra Client\`.  
   Grant full administrator rights (Everyone) to the Spectra Client folder after pasting the files.
-->. Proceed to the Suprema BioMini Plus 2 folder. Copy the indicated files and paste them into the following paths:  
   Paste into: `C:\Windows\System32\`  
   Paste into: `C:\Windows\sysWOW64\`  
-->. Install the x64 and x86 library files on the system as specified.  
-->. Access the services and start the Spectra Client service. Once the service is running, the BioMini installation is complete.  
-->. Proceed to the iApp login and Employee Master. Click “Take Finger,” then place the finger on the device when the red light blinks to register it in the software.

As a result, you may experience intermittent service disruptions between 9th and 12th December 2024. We kindly request your cooperation in communicating this information to the relevant stakeholders at your end to ensure a smooth migration process and minimise any potential impact. Continuity Plan Please note that terminal hardwares will remain fully accessible to pre-enrolled users during the migration. However, Web application, the proper live transactions and bio reports will only be available once the migration is completed. Additionally, for any new joiners during this period, please share the employee details in the attached format to the undersigned please. @ Dear Regional Ops. comments: we check that your iAPP is not getting connection from database and It appears that your server system is currently in restarting mode.
solution: As per our recent remote session, we encountered an issue with the device server IP. When we added the new server IP to the device, it went into offline mode. However, when we reverted to the old server IP, the device worked fine. Despite opening the port on your new server, the issue persisted. After further investigation, we identified a problem with the Spectra worker process, which found Hercules software. The issue occurred while listening to the port and restarting the worker process. To resolve this, we added the spectrabase.db file to the service folder of iAPP, which resolved the Spectra worker process issue. Following that, we faced difficulties migrating the database to the new server. As per our discussion, you have completed this task on your side. Since you are moving the database to the new server, we will need to make changes to the spectrabase.db file once the migration process is complete. After that, we can proceed with the next steps. As agreed, we will reconnect tomorrow to continue this process.

If, exceptionally, any site's attendance for November 2024 has not yet been finalised or validated, kindly share the details. Your no reply will be considered as your concurrence for the same. We would like to inform you that planned backend maintenance will be carried out to enhance server performance. As a result, you may experience intermittent service disruptions between 9th and 12th December 2024. We kindly request your cooperation in communicating this information to the relevant stakeholders at your end to ensure a smooth migration process and minimise any potential impact. Continuity Plan Please note that terminal hardwares will remain fully accessible to pre-enrolled users during the migration. However, Web application, the proper live transactions and bio reports will only be available once the migration is completed. Additionally, for any new joiners during this period, please share the employee details in the attached format to the undersigned please. @ Dear Regional Ops. Team, Kindly ensure the compliance of your respective clustered sites have received this email and aligned with the planned activity as outlined. @ Dear Site Client POCs & Zonal Heads, This email is for your information only. Please note that this is an update and requires no action from your end. Thank you for your understanding and continued support.

solution: As per our recent remote session, we encountered an issue with the device server IP. When we added the new server IP to the device, it went into offline mode. However, when we reverted to the old server IP, the device worked fine. Despite opening the port on your new server, the issue persisted. After further investigation, we identified a problem with the Spectra worker process, which found Hercules software. The issue occurred while listening to the port and restarting the worker process. To resolve this, we added the spectrabase.db file to the service folder of iAPP, which resolved the Spectra worker process issue. Following that, we faced difficulties migrating the database to the new server. As per our discussion, you have completed this task on your side. Since you are moving the database to the new server, we will need to make changes to the spectrabase.db file once the migration process is complete. After that, we can proceed with the next steps. As agreed, we will reconnect tomorrow to continue this process.

description_plain: Hi Aditya, As discussed, we are facing technical challenges with newly procure HID I-Class card from Spectra. None of cards are readable either on BIO & Access devices. We have many new employees on board and we are not able to add them in our system and they will not be marked in attendance system. Please treat this email as very critical towards earliest solution.
comments: User will connect at their convenience time once they installed the remote application.
solution:
We took a remote session with the user and found that the user had assigned new cards to employees, but the employees were unable to punch on the device using the assigned card ID.
We asked the user to try punching on the device and discovered that the downloaded card ID was different from the assigned card ID given to the employee.
We added the correct card ID from the download and assigned it to the employee. As you confirmed, it is now working as expected.

name: iApp
description_plain: Kindly arrange to resolve the query for pending at system. We have mapped the hierarchy. Pls do it. Employee id 110504
comments:
1. The client reported that after the overtime hierarchy was applied, the OT is still not showing in the sanction application and is marked as pending in the system.
2. I opened the overtime/COFF page and found that all the applications are showing as pending in the system.
3. I opened the overtime hierarchy, filtered the employee, and found that the final approval is defined correctly.
4. After that, I opened the attendance sheet of the employee and found that all the shift changes occurred after the overtime application was applied, so this needs to be discussed with the client.
solution:
1. The client reported that overtime is showing as pending in the system for the months of November and December.  
2. I went to the overtime hierarchy and found that final approval is defined correctly in the system.  
3. After that, I checked whether final approval was active, and it was showing as active.  
4. I accessed the Zydus server and executed the following query to reschedule the overtime pending applications:  
   
   ```sql
   SELECT * FROM adjustapply (nolock) WHERE category='Overtime' AND SendAppTo='-10' AND laststatus IN('P','U') AND f7=1
   AND attddate BETWEEN '2024-09-26' AND '2024-12-09'  
   UPDATE adjustapply SET f7 = NULL WHERE category='Overtime' AND SendAppTo='-10' AND laststatus IN('P','U') AND f7=1
   AND attddate BETWEEN '2024-09-26' AND '2024-12-09'  
   ```

5. After updating the query, I restarted the Spectra worker process, and now the rescheduled applications have started. A total of 35,000 records were processed and cleared.  
6. I waited for some time to ensure all records were cleared. Afterward, I checked and found that applications are now showing as pending at final approval, but some applications are still pending in the system.  
7. I opened the attendance sheet of the employee and found that the extra hours were not worked after the shift ended and also shift is assign wrong to the employee, which is why the applications are still pending in the system.

Thanks &
comments: I will check and update the client.
solution:
The issue you reported is occurring because the user applied for COFF leave from 03/09/2024 to 06/09/2024, and again on 08/09/2024 and 09/09/2024. This leave was approved before the location transfer. The user’s location transfer request was applied on 28/09/2024, with an effective date of 01/09/2024.

It again deduct balance for Pipan Location.

Currently, our software does not restrict the admin for this process . Our team is working on a solution to either restrict this action or ensure that the leave balance is not recalculated.

After the update, we checked Mr. Jignesh Patel’s punch data and encountered the error: **EmpID Int.Fail - Card Not Properly Read in iApp**.

We then surrendered the newly assigned card, reassigned the old card to Mr. Patel, and re-read the card in iApp. Once access was granted, Mr. Patel was able to punch in with his old card as well.

There is no issue with the card or software; the issue occurred because the card was not properly read.
